chapters.title: Chapter 1501: Ainna’s Plan For Revenge
paragraphs: Kent spent five days indoors to rest and recover from the exhaustion he had after the three paintings. The majority of that time was spent with Lene pleasuring him.
She made it known to Kent that they should hold off on their first time for now. Once they located Inaya, they could take that step.
Kent didn’t mind, so she only played with his dick the entire time.

Once he recovered and she had had enough, they decided to go out. By then, Fallon and Vika had also returned from the tower. Considering it had been five days since they entered the tower, they had spent 120 days plus in there.
This allowed them to catch up on a lot of things, helping them grow much closer than they were a few days ago.
Kent and Lene were happy for them. Since they had managed to take the first step, the next step, when they faced each other’s heart demons, they would easily defeat them.

Kent then told Fallon to contact Lady Annette and inform her that he wanted to meet in person. She did, and considering Lady Annette had been eagerly waiting for her call for the past five days, she was more than happy to accept Kent’s request.
Once that was done, they freshened up and left their room, making their way down to the lobby. Just as they arrived at the lobby, Kent stopped and turned his head to the left.
His gaze landed on two ladies having morning tea, oblivious to anything happening around them.
"What is wrong?" Lene asked, seeing her master stop abruptly.
Kent didn’t reply immediately. He first looked around the lobby for a few seconds before sighing.
"Nothing to be worried about, Lene. I felt an evil presence just now. Maybe it may have had something to do with what I saw in the painting,"
Lene hugged his arm and said:
"All the more reason to find Lady Inaya fast. Since she is the only one who can help you, finding her as fast as possible should be our priority."

"Lene is right. Once these paintings are auctioned, your fame will skyrocket. We can use that to gain access to a Teleportation Gate or a continental teleportation channel," Fallon also added, causing Kent to smile.
He had already briefed her and Vika on the main reason he came to Planet Brymrr, so they knew his mission was very important.
"While meeting the crazy lady is the last thing I want, I have no choice but to see her since she is indeed the only person who can help me."
Lene and the ladies smiled. Lene then said:

"You are only saying that because you haven’t yet recovered all your memories. Who knows, maybe you and she were the best of friends in the past. Maybe she is even the mother of your unknown child." The girls giggled, and Kent just smirked.
"That is a big maybe. For me, I know she was the crazy woman who tried to kill me 124 times simply because I declined to have a duel with her." Kent looked around, still sensing the evil presence.
Seeing he couldn’t find where it was coming from, he gestured for the ladies to leave. Soon, they were gone from the hotel.
A few minutes after they were gone, a glass standing on a table, placed before two beautiful immortals, shattered.
The purple-haired lady giggled. "Evil and crazy lady, huh. Looks like your prince charming is still hung up on your crazy youth."
The expression on Inaya’s beautiful face contorted into a deadly frown. Seeing this, Ainna laughed. "I guess coming with you was the best decision I ever made."

Inaya said nothing, but deep down, it pained her heart that Kent had not yet recovered all his memories of Jest. If he had, perhaps she would have felt good about the punishment she had prepared for him.
"He called me crazy, huh. I guess I will become that crazy lady again and teach him a very good lesson."
"How do you plan on doing that? You heard them; they want to cross over continents to find you."
Inaya smiled and snapped her finger, causing the shattered glass to reform, every fragment restoring itself to its perfect state.
"That is precisely why this will be fun. Since he seems to have become aware that using the sea to travel is dangerous, he plans to use the channel or the teleportation gates."
A grin formed on her face. "If I were to make it so nobody would grant him passage, he would have no choice but to take the sea. That is where my revenge would start."
Ainna looked at her friend for a few seconds before a smirk formed on her face. "Looks like you have become dumb after sleeping for two eras."
Inaya took no offense, since she knew that when it came to scheming, Ainna was second to none.
"Clearly, you saw how those two returned to his side. If I didn’t know better, I would say he possesses a pocket dimension or a treasure that allows him to come and go as he pleases.
If that is the case, then what makes you think he wouldn’t just run and hide when there is danger?"

Inaya nodded to her words, sensing a downside to her initial plan. If Kent could come and go as he pleased, then crossing the sea would, in a way, be simple. When danger threatened, he could slip away; once it passed, he would return and continue his journey.
If only they knew that, as soon as there was danger, entering the tower would become impossible, they would have gone with Inaya’s plan.
But unfortunately for Kent, Ainna already meant to hurt him, so now that she had the floor, she decided to come up with a very dangerous plan.
"First of all, I will find a way to temporarily cut his connection to whatever he has that allows him and his ladies to come and go.
But before that, you heard them mention an auction. Why don’t we follow them and see what they are up to first?
If he has something to auction, we first let him gain fame, but before he can make use of it, we crush him so hard that he has no choice but to use the sea.
I sense that the lady who was all over him is a demigod. This suggests he may have stronger backing in this life than in his previous one. This means he can call for backup.

Luckily, I have that artefact that can render him in a vacuum where calling for help would be impossible. At the end of the day, we want him to use the sea, because that is the only way we can reach him and force him to face his true despair."
Inaya continued to stare at her friend for a few minutes after she finished her plan. "Good lord, Ainna, when did you become this evil?"
Ainna smiled. "I had billions of years to think of the best ways to get back at him. You can say this is the easiest I can go on, considering he is a mortal at the moment."
Inaya just shook her head. After thinking for a few minutes, she nodded. "Let’s follow your plan. First of all, make it so he cannot call for backup and cut his connection to his pocket dimension."
Ainna nodded, knowing her evil—errh, genius — plan would soon cause Kent to despair.

chapters.title: Chapter 1502: Meeting Lady Annette
paragraphs: After leaving the hotel, Fallon led everyone to Lady Annette’s store. She had already been informed that they would be coming today, so she had prepared to welcome them.
Along the way, they heard whispers of a young swordsman disrespecting the son of a certain demigod. Because of that, the demigod had sent people to look for and capture him.
Kent, who knew he was the one they were looking for, merely smiled. Lene held the same expression since she was there when Kent disciplined the bastard.
In truth, she knew Kent could have killed the brat if he had wanted to.
The reason had to do with two things.

First is the fact that he had already reached a level of understanding that sword kings, regardless of how long they had lived, would not be able to achieve. In his memories of Jest, he had already lived to the point where he reached the peak of the Sword Legend stage.
That knowledge, combined with the fact that he had met the Sword Dao and even inherited a part of its legacy, raised his understanding to a level no simple swordsman could attain.
That Sword Divine stood no chance.
Maybe if it had been a martial contest of cultivation, he would have won. But with how robust Kent’s sword energy had become, his defeat was justified.
After walking for a few minutes, they arrived at the store. It was crowded as ever. However, they aren’t about to join any queue.
"Ah, Lady Fallon, welcome back. My Lady is expecting you."
Unlike before, when she had to walk to the main gate, they were led to a side door and taken straight to a meeting room prepared for this meeting.
The moment they entered, Kent’s eyes landed on Lady Annette, causing him to furrow his brow. ’So harmless, yet mysterious.’
While she did not have much knowledge when it came to martial cultivation, Kent could tell there was something about her that made him feel like she was dangerous.

"Welcome, honoured guest. I am Lady Annette, the owner of the Blue Haven Antique Shop," Lady Annette said with a polite smile. "I have worked with Fallon a few times, and judging by how excellent her service is, I have a feeling she would not recommend you if she did not believe in your art."
Her words were directed at Kent, making him realize she was aware he was the one Fallon had talked about.
Kent smiled. "Looks like you do not only have eyes for antiques, you have eyes for people, too."
"Not as detailed and clever as Fallon, but I get by,"

"Well, you would not be disappointed with what I have to show today. But before that, I want to know how you run your business. Depending on the outcome of today’s discussion, there is a chance of having more dealings in the future."

"Very confident of you to say that. Though I must ask, how sure are you that today’s dealings will go anywhere? In case you are getting the wrong idea, know that I only granted this meeting because Fallon asked me to.

You may not think much of me, considering I was eager to meet you. However, when it comes to dealing in antiques and rare treasures, I am among the top three on the entire Ice Continent and within the top 20 in the entire world.
So, to answer your question, I am not someone too eager to acquire rare art. While I would love to have it, I have seen many paintings that I am sure yours cannot—"
Lady Annette’s words caught in her throat when three paintings appeared from thin air. Her eyes widened, and for a moment, Kent saw she was lost for what to even think.
’Not the first sight I have seen, and it most certainly would not be the last,’ Kent said inwardly.
Standing on a mountain 20,000 km from Lady Annette’s store, Inaya and Ainna also widened their eyes.
"S-Spirit Paintings," Ainna muttered, her shocked look saying a lot more than she would have loved to, considering how much she hates Kent.
"Died a swordsman and came back a Spirit Painter," Inaya muttered. "Just what have you become, Jest?"
Inside the meeting room, Kent smiled:
"What do you think, good enough to make the top three antique dealers in the Ice Continent take me up on my offer?"
Lady Annette nodded like a kid being presented with candy. Seeing this, Fallon and the others smiled. They knew Kent had nothing to fear since his paintings were just out of this world.

"These three paintings are just too much for even me." She turned her gaze toward Kent and asked, "How did you come up with these concepts? No, a better question: how were you able to create something this profound?"
"An artist never reveals his secrets. That said, these are just a sneak peek into what I am capable of. If you want more, you must first listen to my terms."
"I am all ears,"
"My offer is simple. Aside from the Demon Heart Gaze, you can pick one of the two remaining and keep it. The other one, alongside the Demon Heart Gaze, will be auctioned.
Of course, we both know such a painting will earn you more than you will be spending. This is why the second thing I want from you is to use your Teleportation Gate to travel to the Elven Continent.

We will pay for the Spirit Crystals involved. If these conditions are met, I will provide three more paintings, which you can either put on display or auction. In the future, if I have more paintings, I will remember you."
"I accept."
"That was fast."
"If you had any idea how rare Spirit Paintings are these days, you would not have given me one for free. That said, since you have given it to me, you cannot take it back."
Kent smiled. "I am not petty, Lady Annette. But the same applies to you; since we have come to an agreement, you cannot go back on your word."𝚏𝕣𝕖𝚎𝚠𝚎𝚋𝚗𝐨𝐯𝕖𝕝.𝕔𝐨𝕞
"Don’t worry. You can use my teleportation gate whenever you want."

What Kent did not know was that, after the Era of the Divine Beast Tamer, the world of Spirit Painters continued to grow for a few more eras before, out of nowhere, the Soul Temple struck, and over 95% of them were either captured or killed.
The few that remained went into hiding, some even dropping their brush and promising to never touch them again. Just as Immortal Crystals have become rare, Spirit Paintings are the same, even rarer.
Kent, of course, did not know that. But even if he did, he isn’t afraid of the soul temple, not when he planned to destroy them. He could easily paint more because he had the means.
"Take this. It is a VIP pass for the auction happening in a week’s time. Fallon knows the auction house, so do well to come."
Kent received the token and stored it in his space ring.
"By the way, what name should I tell the auctioneer?"
"My name is Jaqen, but when it comes to my painter name, tell them these paintings came from the Nine Stars Chaos Brush."
He thought long and hard about the name he would be using, and this felt better. In the past, he was called the Nine Destiny Divine Brush.

chapters.title: Chapter 1503: Ainna’s Insidious Plan
paragraphs: After handling a few more talks and finalizing their deal, the meeting finally came to an end.
They concluded that the day after the auction, they would use the teleportation gate to travel to the Elven continent. Once they get there, he will figure out the rest.
"Fallon, can I have a few words with you before you leave?" Lady Annette requested after Kent and his ladies were about to leave.
Fallon turned and looked at Kent. "Wait for me downstairs. I will be back shortly."
Kent nodded, and they walked out of the meeting room. After they were gone, Lady Annette began to speak...

"I received word from some of my people in the Elven Continent. Lord Hunter is aware you are in the Ice continent and that his trusted assassin has also betrayed him. I hear he has deployed three demigods after you, and they will be here in a few days.
It would be best if you leave before they arrive. Also, do well to avoid using any of the channels you used to travel in the past. He has people monitoring all of them."

Fallon nodded. "Thank you for telling me these things, Lady Annette. I will remember your generosity. However, you do not have to worry about me. If Lord Hunter himself were to come, I am sure I would be fine."
Lady Annette furrowed her brow, but she said nothing.
Since Fallon had the time to come back to work while being hunted by a god and his minions, she knew she might have also found herself a powerhouse.
This deduction, however, made her reexamine Kent’s image in her mind again. There is no doubt that Fallon’s confidence is because of him.
’I wonder what backing that kid has,’ she said inwardly. In the end, she had no reason to pry into others’ business, so she advised Fallon one last time before letting her leave.
"Be careful. Even if you are not afraid of him, keeping your guard up is also key to survival."
"I will take that to heart, Lady Annette." Fallon left and joined Kent, Vika, and Lene downstairs.
They soon left and started heading back to the round-up store. Kent plans to paint a couple more pieces of art, so they will go there first; if there is time later, they will head back to the hotel.
Meanwhile, atop the mountain, Ainna watched Kent and his ladies leave, a smile playing on her lips.
"What are you happy about?" Inaya asked.

"I have found the perfect plan to get back at that scumbag. Initially, I wanted him to have no choice but to take the sea route if he wanted to get to the Elven Continent. However, thinking about it now, that would be dangerous to the others who might be on the ship with him.

Aside from them, that lady had just given him her word that she would allow him and his ladies to use her teleportation gate. Forcing her to go back on her word is too evil. I may be wicked, but not evil.
That said, hearing that three demigods are after one of his ladies, making sure they know the right place to go would not be too evil, don’t you think?"
Inaya sighed, hearing what Ainna had planned. She wants to use the three demigods sent by Lord Hunter to punish Kent.
"Until every bone in his body is broken, I am sure I wouldn’t get the satisfaction I desire. This bastard needs to be taught a good lesson."𝑓𝑟ℯ𝘦𝓌𝘦𝘣𝑛𝑜𝓋𝑒𝓁.𝑐ℴ𝓂

"But three demigods... isn’t that too much? He may be the greatest swordsman to have ever lived, but the current him is nothing compared to who he was. Pairing him against such odds is just being cruel at this point."
"Technically, he would only be facing one demigod. The demigod lady beside him will take one, the two ladies will also take on one, leaving the last one all to him."
Inaya sighed again. "The moment his life is in danger, I will step in, and you had better not try to stop me."
"You are being uptight, Inaya. Of course, I am not planning on killing him. I just want him to have a taste of what he had done to you and how much it cost me."
"Fine. Go ahead and do your thing. I will get my revenge when he has all his memories back."
They stayed on the mountain, but they could see everything Kent was doing.
Meanwhile, back in the city, the mysterious swordsman who dared strike the son of a demigod was still being hunted down.
The demigod whose son Kent had sent flying through the wall of the restaurant is one of the City Lords in Snow City. There are five of them and a single City Overlord.
This particular City Lord loves his only son a little too much. Thanks to him, the boy gets to do as he pleases. So when he heard that his son had been struck, he became furious.
Unfortunately for him, while he could have gotten to the truth, Lene had tampered with the memories of everyone present at the restaurant during the altercation.
So he was betting on whether or not he would get lucky and find Kent.

While that was happening, Kent and his ladies returned to the rundown store, and he started painting. The plan was to paint at least five artworks. However, he added one last painting he planned to gift to his nemesis when they finally met.
If only he were aware that the person he wanted to give the horrendous painting to had seen the entire process, he would have found a different person to court death with.
By the time he realised what a blunder he had caused, it would already be too late.
Days soon passed, and before long, the day of the auction had come. It was one of the biggest auctions on the Ice Continent, so even beings from the six other continents came.
Kent came prepared financially. He had forgotten he had a goddess all this time. Vexthra had handed him a sizable amount of spirit stones, so he had nothing to worry about.
As for Vexthra and her team, they were still on the 11th floor waiting for Velyra. She had not finished absorbing the blood.
As for Avotha and his team, they had collected the mission contract and left for Planet Skar. As Vexthra suspected, it would take them two months to reach Planet Skar.
However, since they are not needed right now, their absence would not be missed. That said, Yi Lai’s new subordinate had also not passed his Dragon Ascension Trial yet.
So they will probably remain on the 11th floor for a while longer.
Kent and his three ladies made their way to the auction, unaware that very soon hell would rain down on them.

Inaya and Ainna somehow managed to enter the auction house as well. Kent, of course, had no idea who they were. He had seen them at the hotel a few times, so when he saw them seated in one of the VIP rooms, he did not think too much about it.
He came for the Spirit Brush, and so nothing else mattered.
Lady Annette met Fallon a few minutes after they entered. After waiting for ten minutes, the auction house was closed, and the auctioneer, a beautiful goddess, walked onto the stage.

sentences.text: After handling a few more talks and finalizing their deal, the meeting finally came to an end.
They concluded that the day after the auction, they would use the teleportation gate to travel to the Elven continent.
Once they get there, he will figure out the rest.
"Fallon, can I have a few words with you before you leave?" Lady Annette requested after Kent and his ladies were about to leave.
Fallon turned and looked at Kent.
"Wait for me downstairs.
I will be back shortly."
Kent nodded, and they walked out of the meeting room.
After they were gone, Lady Annette began to speak...
"I received word from some of my people in the Elven Continent.
Lord Hunter is aware you are in the Ice continent and that his trusted assassin has also betrayed him.
I hear he has deployed three demigods after you, and they will be here in a few days.
It would be best if you leave before they arrive.
Also, do well to avoid using any of the channels you used to travel in the past.
He has people monitoring all of them."
Fallon nodded.
"Thank you for telling me these things, Lady Annette.

There is no doubt that Fallon’s confidence is because of him.
’I wonder what backing that kid has,’ she said inwardly.
In the end, she had no reason to pry into others’ business, so she advised Fallon one last time before letting her leave.
"Be careful.

"I will take that to heart, Lady Annette." Fallon left and joined Kent, Vika, and Lene downstairs.

I may be wicked, but not evil.

She wants to use the three demigods sent by Lord Hunter to punish Kent.

chapters.title: Chapter 1504: Dream Gate Auction House
paragraphs: The Dream Gate Auction House is one of the three S-Tier auction houses on the Ice Continent. It is famed for auctioning off some of the rarest and most powerful treasures ever to reach this part of the universe.
As an S-Tier auction house, their reputation is of great importance; that is why, when a rare treasure comes to them, they first examine it to ensure it is authentic before putting it up for auction.
Many know this, so they have no doubt that today’s auction will have only authentic treasures.
The invited guests are all powerful people living on Planet Brymrr.
Kent counted over ten gods, some of whom he could sense were True Gods. This made him become weary of their presence.
He had no idea that the two ladies he had ignored were the true monsters at the auction house today. In his head, they were but two Immortal Lords with a lot of money to spend at the auction.

On the stage, a goddess known widely by many as Lady Tilly scanned the entire auction house and smiled. Seeing her beautiful smile, the perverts seated all around also smiled, putting on lustful expressions.

"Welcome, everyone, to yet another annual auction event. Last year, we auctioned some of our best treasures yet. We saw how you loved them, and so this year, we decided to go even bigger." Her warm smile felt enchanting as she looked at the various VIP rooms.

"First of all, I would like to thank the people who believed in us and decided to use our service to auction off their treasures. Your contribution and trust will not be misplaced, and it most certainly will not go without our sincere gratitude.
A special thanks also goes to Lord Brandon, who decided to put one of his crafts on the list of items to be auctioned today."
Murmurs began to spread as people smiled and beamed with anticipation. Kent, who had no idea who this Brandon guy was, remained seated, unsure why they seemed so happy.
Thankfully, Lady Tilly revealed all he needed to know next:

"As we all know, Lord Brandon is one of the finest god-level blacksmiths in this world. He has created some of the best treasures we have seen in recent years. Today, one of his newest creations will be auctioned, and I look forward to seeing who wins that bid."
After waiting for the murmurs to die down, she added one last sentence that instantly caused everyone inside the auction house to stir.
"We are also privileged to announce that, at the end of today’s auction, two spirit paintings will be auctioned."
This statement caused everyone to murmur, some even making their voices heard by all...
"Lady Tilly, why weren’t we informed before today?"

At high-profile auctions like this, months before the main event, a list is sent to most invited guests, detailing the items to be auctioned. This is to ensure that they come prepared and that no one’s time is wasted.

Of course, in most auction houses, a few items will not be added to the list. But something as important as a spirit painting would most certainly be included. Given how rare they are, people would love to know about them and prepare well before coming.
"Sorry for not including it in the list of items we will be auctioning. As many of you may have guessed, it was a last-minute addition."
Her apologetic words calmed everyone down.
It was not like they could reprimand her for something this trivial. Since they are here now, they might as well try their luck, and whoever comes with deep pockets will win the bid.

"Since we have that out of the way, then, as usual, in here, those with huge pockets get to have the treasure. Nobody should threaten anyone using their family background or strength. Those can be done outside this auction house.

If you do not have the money, do not place a bid. Failure to pay will result in a permanent ban from all our establishments. All bids are in high-grade spirit stones. However, you can pay in spirit crystals, immortal stones, or even god stones. The rich folks can also go for celestial stones.
Lastly, do not, and this is serious, do not fight inside the auction. Doing so will result in severe punishment that none of you is prepared to face.
That said, let the auction begin."
The light dimmed, and a spotlight powered by a formation lit up, illuminating the table where a torn piece of fabric lay inside a glass container.
Many eyes narrowed when they saw this fabric. Clearly, they recognised it.
How could they not? This fabric had caused a war between three god factions. As far as is known, it contains a cryptic map that, if deciphered, can lead one to a great treasure.
Many fought over it, some even dying in the process. However, after calming down, they realised the map is not something just anyone can use. It requires a great intellect to decipher it.

"I know we all recognise this piece of fabric. But to those who do not, it is a map that leads to a treasure said to have been left behind by a powerful Celestial Blacksmith who lived during the Flame Era.
Rumour even has it that he was also a disciple of the same sect where the legendary Nine Immortal Flame Blacksmith crafted his first-ever Celestial artefact.
Over the years, this map has caused mayhem, resulting in the deaths of thousands. However, even after sending it to the Cult of Wisdom, it could not be deciphered.
You can now say it has lost its value.
This is why the Hiana clan wants to part with it. The starting bid is placed at 100,000 spirit stones."
In the first minute, nobody placed a bid until Kent placed his:
Nobody said anything; they just turned and looked at Kent. In their minds, he just wanted to win something at the auction, so, seeing no one say anything, he placed a bid.
Five minutes later, Lady Tilly sighed and was about to announce Kent as the winner when a certain red-haired human placed her own bid.
"Huh," Kent turned and looked at VIP Room 3. When their gazes met, the lady raised her glass and cheered at him.
Kent said nothing and raised the bid by 10,000. However, he was not done when the redhead raised the bid again.

Kent did not immediately counter. Instead, he narrowed his gaze at the lady for a few seconds before a smile formed on his face. He also raised his glass and pointed it at the lady, whom he had no idea was actually Inaya in disguise.

"I never knew a fairy such as yourself was proficient in deciphering the Hexa-Spiral 360 Paradox Grid," he said, his smile widening as he added, "Of course, to get the main grid, you would also have to know something about the Voidscript 888 Recursive Pattern."
Inaya did not answer. Instead, she turned and looked at the map again before turning back to Kent. "Many tried and failed. I am just buying it to destroy it. It has caused too much harm."
"Such a waste. I was actually looking forward to solving some complex computations. It has been a while since I engaged my mind, you see."

chapters.title: Chapter 1505: Buying the map
paragraphs: Everyone present in the auction house knew this map was cursed. The amount of blood shed because of this map was just too much. In the end, it had proven to be a wasted endeavor.
They had all given up hope of deciphering it.

However, hearing Kent and Inaya converse, something told them the handsome young man actually knew what he was saying. After all, the Cult of Wisdom had revealed that the map is inscribed in the Hexa-Spiral 360 Paradox Grid.
It is one of the ancient cryptographic patterns that had long since gone extinct. They claim it was too complex to understand, so over time, many stopped learning it.

Hearing Kent mention the same thing and even add more context told them he knew something about it. However, they did not rack their brains over it since they knew it was not as simple as he made it sound.
"Are you insinuating you can solve the Paradox Grid?" Inaya asked, her expression flat.
"The Paradox Grid involves complex computations, for sure. I will not beat my chest and say I am an expert at solving them; however, I can say I will solve this map.
Also, the patterns here point to a place called..." Kent paused and looked around. Seeing hundreds of eyes locked on him, he smiled and said:
"It leads to a place called Death Valley."
"WHAT"
Be it the people present, Inaya, Ainna, or even Lady Tilly the auctioneer, they all exclaimed upon hearing what Kent said.
"Kid, are you sure?" a man inside VIP Room 5 asked, his expression brightening after the previous frown he’d worn when the starting bid had only been raised by 10,000.
It appeared he was the one who put up the map for sale.

"Yes. It is inscribed in some weird runic text right where the sticky black ink is. This map leads there. However, as to where the treasures are, I would have to decipher the map, which will take a couple of years, a hundred years at most.

That said, I had no plans of venturing to such a dreadful place, so when I decipher it, I will probably release the information to the entire world. I have reasons to believe everyone would love to know where the treasures are hidden."
"Treasures?" This time, it was Inaya who asked. "Are you saying there is more than one treasure?"

"Yes. There is a reason why the owner of this map used the Hexa-Spiral 360 Paradox Grid. Each grid leads to a destination, so since there are 360 grids, we can assume there are 360 treasures. That said, there can be fewer, but definitely not just one.
Once again, if and when I decipher it, I will know more. On that note, I place my final bid at 600,000."
Many turned and looked at Inaya, who took a sip of her drink. After a few minutes, she nodded at Lady Tilly, who nodded back.
"The map is sold to the gentleman in VIP Room 13."
"Thank you, fairy. I will be sure to decipher it and tell you one location just for being generous to me today."
Inaya smiled and replied, "Generosity comes in many forms, kid. Enjoy it while it lasts."
Kent nodded, but then a frown appeared on his face.
In his mind, her words hinted at what would happen when he deciphered the map. Also, he now believed that, once it was known he could decipher the map, his life might be in danger.
Knowing this, he made one move that caused many who were planning to kidnap him and force him to decipher the map for them to smile bitterly.
"Lady Tilly, since I am still growing up, I will trouble you to send the map to the Cult of Wisdom. Tell them the one they have been searching for will come for it in the next 20 years."
"I understand."
This way, even if they kidnapped him, there would be no map to decipher. Kent smiled and raised his glass at Inaya, making her aware he had resolved all kinds of dangers she had hinted at.
She just smiled and took another sip of her wine.
Inside VIP Room 3, Ainna said to Inaya using telepathy...𝕗𝗿𝕖𝐞𝐰𝗲𝕓𝐧𝕠𝕧𝗲𝐥.𝚌𝐨𝚖
"What was that?"
"What do you mean?"
"Why were you flirting with this scumbag?"
"I was not flirting with him."
"Oh, you sure did. I saw how you smiled at him. While a bit narrowed down, it was the same way you used to smile at him back then."
"You are reading too much into everything, Ainna. I did not flirt with him."
Ainna said nothing afterwards. She turned to look in Kent’s direction only to see him staring at her. She locked gazes with him for a few seconds before turning away.
By then, the second item was brought to the stage. It was a flower-type herb, and judging by its fragrance alone, it was not lower than a Tier 25 herb.
"This is a Tier 26 intelligent herb called the Solar Flare Dominion Flower. It can be used as an enhancer herb for every flame-related pill.
Luckily, though rare, a generous alchemist decided to auction it with a starting bid of 100 million spirit stones. You can raise the bid by 1 million spirit stones."
"200 million."
"300 million."
"500 million."
"1 billion."

The bid was quickly raised to a billion, and it showed no sign of stopping there. Kent looked long and hard at the herb, but despite telling himself that buying and saving it for the future made sense, he ultimately decided against it.
He had already made his presence known. If he were to get into the bad books of these immortals and demigods, he might just end up dying in all kinds of mysterious ways.
Fallon had already informed him of what Lady Annette had told her, so he was being extra careful.
In the end, the herb sold for 24 billion spirit stones. That amount is enough to sustain a medium world for billions of years.

They use low-grade spirit stones. A hundred of those is one medium-grade spirit stone, and 100 of those is one high-grade spirit stone. This means one high-grade spirit stone is equivalent to 10,000 low-grade spirit stones.
Twenty-four billion high-grade spirit stones are more than enough to cater to their needs for all eternity. Yet it was spent casually to purchase just one herb.

Kent shook his head and focused on the next item. It was a god-grade cultivation technique that would benefit yin-type cultivators. As one would expect, the bidding war among the lady cultivators at the auction was fierce. In the end, it sold for 10 billion.
The next item was also brought out: a green shard said to contain divine essence. Naturally, the blacksmiths around fought over it, and in the end, one of them bought it for 13 billion.
More items were brought out and sold for staggering amounts of spirit stones. Through it all, Kent remained quiet, sipping only on his wine.
He had no use for any of the items at present, so he made no move to bid on them. In his mind, one day, when he gets to the level where he will need them, he would not hesitate to bid on them.
So he relaxed and waited for something he could actually use. Finally, after the 10th item was sold, the item he had been informed about before the auction was finally brought out.
It was a green-handled knife that looked more like a dagger. Both the handle and blade were decorated with runes. The moment his eyes landed on it, a smile formed on his face.
The Spirit Brush was finally revealed.

There is a reason why the owner of this map used the Hexa-Spiral 360 Paradox Grid.
Each grid leads to a destination, so since there are 360 grids, we can assume there are 360 treasures.
That said, there can be fewer, but definitely not just one.
Once again, if and when I decipher it, I will know more.
On that note, I place my final bid at 600,000."
Many turned and looked at Inaya, who took a sip of her drink.
After a few minutes, she nodded at Lady Tilly, who nodded back.
"The map is sold to the gentleman in VIP Room 13."
"Thank you, fairy.
I will be sure to decipher it and tell you one location just for being generous to me today."
Inaya smiled and replied, "Generosity comes in many forms, kid.
Enjoy it while it lasts."
Kent nodded, but then a frown appeared on his face.
In his mind, her words hinted at what would happen when he deciphered the map.
Also, he now believed that, once it was known he could decipher the map, his life might be in danger.
Knowing this, he made one move that caused many who were planning to kidnap him and force him to decipher the map for them to smile bitterly.
"Lady Tilly, since I am still growing up, I will trouble you to send the map to the Cult of Wisdom.
Tell them the one they have been searching for will come for it in the next 20 years."
"I understand."
This way, even if they kidnapped him, there would be no map to decipher.
Kent smiled and raised his glass at Inaya, making her aware he had resolved all kinds of dangers she had hinted at.
She just smiled and took another sip of her wine.
Inside VIP Room 3, Ainna said to Inaya using telepathy...𝕗𝗿𝕖𝐞𝐰𝗲𝕓𝐧𝕠𝕧𝗲𝐥.𝚌𝐨𝚖
"What was that?"
"What do you mean?"
"Why were you flirting with this scumbag?"
"I was not flirting with him."
"Oh, you sure did.
I saw how you smiled at him.
While a bit narrowed down, it was the same way you used to smile at him back then."
"You are reading too much into everything, Ainna.
I did not flirt with him."
Ainna said nothing afterwards.
She turned to look in Kent’s direction only to see him staring at her.
She locked gazes with him for a few seconds before turning away.
By then, the second item was brought to the stage.
It was a flower-type herb, and judging by its fragrance alone, it was not lower than a Tier 25 herb.
"This is a Tier 26 intelligent herb called the Solar Flare Dominion Flower.
It can be used as an enhancer herb for every flame-related pill.
Luckily, though rare, a generous alchemist decided to auction it with a starting bid of 100 million spirit stones.
You can raise the bid by 1 million spirit stones."
"200 million."
"300 million."
"500 million."
"1 billion."
The bid was quickly raised to a billion, and it showed no sign of stopping there.
Kent looked long and hard at the herb, but despite telling himself that buying and saving it for the future made sense, he ultimately decided against it.
He had already made his presence known.
If he were to get into the bad books of these immortals and demigods, he might just end up dying in all kinds of mysterious ways.
Fallon had already informed him of what Lady Annette had told her, so he was being extra careful.
In the end, the herb sold for 24 billion spirit stones.
That amount is enough to sustain a medium world for billions of years.
They use low-grade spirit stones.
A hundred of those is one medium-grade spirit stone, and 100 of those is one high-grade spirit stone.
This means one high-grade spirit stone is equivalent to 10,000 low-grade spirit stones.
Twenty-four billion high-grade spirit stones are more than enough to cater to their needs for all eternity.
Yet it was spent casually to purchase just one herb.
Kent shook his head and focused on the next item.
It was a god-grade cultivation technique that would benefit yin-type cultivators.
As one would expect, the bidding war among the lady cultivators at the auction was fierce.
In the end, it sold for 10 billion.
The next item was also brought out: a green shard said to contain divine essence.
Naturally, the blacksmiths around fought over it, and in the end, one of them bought it for 13 billion.
More items were brought out and sold for staggering amounts of spirit stones.
Through it all, Kent remained quiet, sipping only on his wine.
He had no use for any of the items at present, so he made no move to bid on them.
In his mind, one day, when he gets to the level where he will need them, he would not hesitate to bid on them.
So he relaxed and waited for something he could actually use.
Finally, after the 10th item was sold, the item he had been informed about before the auction was finally brought out.
It was a green-handled knife that looked more like a dagger.
Both the handle and blade were decorated with runes.
The moment his eyes landed on it, a smile formed on his face.
The Spirit Brush was finally revealed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1506: Spirit Brush
paragraphs: The moment the spirit brush was brought out, Kent shifted in his seat.
He didn’t know if this was merely a coincidence or fate doing its thing. He really didn’t care. What he wanted was the spirit brush disguised as a knife, now up for bidding.
"Our next item is an Immortal Grade Spirit Brush found in a ruin 30,000 years ago. It was rumoured to have belonged to a legendary spirit painter several million years ago.
Bidding starts at 300 million spirit stones."
"400 million"
"500 million"
"600 million"
Bids started to fly in. Kent held back, of course, and began observing the dozens of people who seemed to be interested in the brush. They had already started to fight over it.

’While it is not one of the Celestial Spirit Brushes, if I were to get my hands on it, I would be able to do calligraphy too, instead of merely painting,’ Kent said inwardly, watching as one bid after another was called.
In no time, the price entered the billions, and it kept climbing.
Kent could confidently say that none of them were spirit painters. However, there was no denying that a spirit brush is more than just a painting tool.
It can be used by array experts to draw runes much more easily. In fact, compared to rune knives, spirit brushes make it relatively simple to inscribe runes related to the soul.
So while they may not be spirit painters, they most certainly have uses for the spirit brush.

Unfortunately for them, Kent came to this auction specifically for that. He wanted to have it so that, aside from merely painting, he could go into calligraphy, where a single word can be invoked to manifest calamities.
"10 billion"

Soon, the bid reached 10 billion, and with that, half of the bidders dropped out. While having it would be great, learning that spirit paintings would be auctioned made them back out when the price entered a certain range.
Kent still remained calm, his focus rooted on the brush.

He knew that, aside from people buying it for formations and arrays, collectors among the bidders were also bidding over it. If they could add an antique that once belonged to a famous spirit painter, their fame would skyrocket.

It was a bit funny and silly that people would just put it on display when it could be used for so much more. There are clear uses for some of the things they put on display. However, in the end, it all boils down to whether or not they have the means to buy it.
"15 billion"
The bid was raised by 2 billion, causing many still bidding to sigh and back out. Then, soon, many left, leaving it with two. They fought for a few minutes, raising the bid to 20 billion.
That was when Kent made his move.
"21 billion"
The moment he joined, all eyes turned in his direction. Many who were in the race from the start wondered why he had waited for the two people bidding to anticipate victory before placing his bid.
It was as if he wanted to weed out the bugs before joining the race. However, with him joining the two people already bidding, the bidding started again.
The two each raised it by 500 million, soon taking the entire price pool to 22 billion. However, Kent remained calm and merely raised the bid by a billion.
"23 billion"

The other two bidders didn’t drop out and kept raising it for nearly another 10 minutes, bringing the bid to 31 billion. By then, Kent could tell one of them was planning on dropping out, so he waited for them to keep going.
When the bid entered 34 billion, the man in VIP room 23 sighed, "You win, Old Blaze. Just be sure to give me a discount when I ask for an array for my daughter."
"Don’t worry, Old Keith, I will give you the biggest discount."
Kent remained quiet for a few moments, then he made his true move.
"36 billion."
The man who had just spoken, hoping to have finally won the bid, coughed a few times, his expression narrowing toward VIP room 13.

He clearly hated the idea that someone was still fighting over the brush with him. He is a demigod, one of the Lords of Snow City. However, a mere kid decided to go against him over an item he very much desired.
He is one of the most popular formation experts in the city and across the continent. As a unique world, there are many powerful people around. Among the demigods, he is one of the powerful ones.
His reputation precedes him. So he most certainly started to wonder why someone still dared to bid against him.
If not because it was against the rules to threaten someone over a bid, he would have already made Kent aware of the kind of person he was messing with.
In fact, if only both of them knew they were related somehow, perhaps the spirit brush would be the last thing they would worry about.
After all, Kent had disrespected his son about two weeks ago. When he heard it, he became furious and ordered men to search for him.
Now, in what could be termed as a coincidence, he met the brat again, and this time, it was him Kent was trying to offend.
"The price is set at 36 billion. Are there no new bids?" Lady Tilly asked, her focus turning toward the VIP room Lord Blaze was in.
She waited for a few moments before announcing Kent as the winner. Kent became a bit stunned when he was announced as the winner.
He had no idea why Lord Blaze didn’t place any more bids. Someone like him wouldn’t shy away from pulling out 100 billion spirit stones.
So if that was the case, why did he just stop? In the end, he had no reason to wonder too much since he had no idea who the redheaded man was. Of course, he suspected he would find out soon enough.
But with the spirit brush now being his, he didn’t care too much. With what he had in mind, now that he had the spirit brush, the universe would start to see his greatness.
After the brush was sold, five more items were auctioned, but Kent didn’t bother to place a bid. However, after the five items were sold, the next item brought out made Kent shift in his chair again.
Inside his soul sea, Gaap also snapped his eyes open.
"We need to get this sword."
Both of them muttered the same sentence.
On the stage, two halves of a broken sword were put on a white cloth. Many inside the auction hall narrowed their eyes, clearly not expecting there to be a broken sword on display.
Even without saying anything, they knew such a worthless thing shouldn’t be on display for bidding. However, some changed their minds when Lady Tilly began introducing the item.
"This broken sword was donated by the Nine Bridge Sword Guild to be auctioned, believing that hidden within it is a manual containing a unique martial technique for supreme sword aura.
Nobody has ever managed to figure out how to go about it, which is why they have set the starting bid at 10 million. It may be a waste, but who knows if they were also telling the truth?"
"11 million," Kent raised the bid after a couple of quiet seconds.

chapters.title: Chapter 1507: Buying a Broken Sword
paragraphs: There was just no way Kent could tell that the two pieces of the broken sword were valuable. In the eyes of everyone, the two swords were just two broken scraps of metal.
Just like with the map, this was also useless until he placed a bid.
Already, the people in the hall witnessed Kent’s intelligence during the incident with the map. That incident made them aware of the kind of intellect he has when it comes to profound matters.
So the moment he placed the bid, they knew he saw something in the swords.
Those who wanted to know what he saw in the sword started whispering among themselves until one of the shameless ones manned up and asked.
"Kid, you wouldn’t happen to see some value in these scraps, do you?"

Kent smiled and pointed at the sword, "It is indeed scrap, as you said. However, it is several billion years old. I only recently started my collector career, so you can say I want to buy it for my collection.
I mean, from what I know about collectors, they love collecting antiques. Since this sword is billions of years old, adding it to my collection would make it appear more genuine.
We both know some antiques don’t make sense, but we have them on display."
Kent laughed, causing others to laugh too. They knew he made sense, speaking from a collector’s perspective. They do collect scraps that once had sentimental value.
So, hearing that he merely wants this scrap of metal for its sentimental value made them sigh.

Some of them were disappointed this time; he said nothing that would have given them a reason to act. Revealing that the treasures left behind by the famed blacksmith were inside Death Valley made them hopeful.
However, since these scraps of metal weren’t really worth anything, they could only sigh and lean back in their seats.
Inside the VIP room 3, Inaya and Ainna shook their heads and sighed too. While they expected Kent to reveal something, they knew he wouldn’t, especially if these items truly held something of value.
They were the only two people who knew his true identity. They knew what Kent was capable of, and so they believed he wouldn’t have placed a bid if the scrap of metal had no value.
"Should I spoil his fun?" Ainna asked through telepathy.𝕗𝐫𝐞𝕖𝕨𝐞𝗯𝚗𝕠𝘃𝐞𝚕.𝐜𝗼𝚖

"No," Inaya replied. "I know him, and I know that if he were to lose these swords, he would make it a thing for the next thousands of years. I have fought against him on things related to swords in the past, and so while we can indeed pull a fast one over him now, considering he is as weak as they come, let’s save ourselves some future troubles."
"Are you afraid of him?" Ainna asked, but Inaya merely smiled.
"You can go ahead and act. Just don’t blame me when it backfires on you in the future."
In the end, Ainna chose not to act. In her head, it wasn’t worth the trouble. She had already made provisions for Kent, so soon, there would be some fun to be had.
Nobody else placed a bid. So in the end, the sword was sold for 11 million. Kent was happy because he won the bid unopposed.
Unbeknownst to everyone present, while it was believed there was a supreme sword aura hidden in the sword, what Kent sensed was something entirely different.
He had no idea how, but just when the sword was brought out, he sensed an extreme resentment, the kind that is born from intense hatred, coming from the sword.

Maybe it was because his current sword was also born out of resentment. However, the kind he felt from the broken sword was just too potent. Gaap also felt it, and so Kent knew he had to use any means to get it.
Now, he had won the bid, and the sword was his to claim.

"Kent, do you really have to buy a broken sword?" Fallon asked, her expression filled with disbelief. "I know you said it is an antique, but from where I stand, I don’t believe that scrap of metal qualifies as an antique."

Kent smiled and used his hand to shush her. "One thing about me, my dear, I don’t buy useless things. I bought the map for a very important reason, and now, this broken sword was also purchased with a purpose in mind."
"So you are saying it isn’t scrap metal,"
"Oh, it is a scrap of metal. However, what is hidden within it is not. If I can repair it, I promise you, it would become the most valuable item that would have sold for hundreds of trillions."
The ladies smiled, a bit stunned that Kent knew all these things but lied through his teeth. They would have frozen from sheer shock when questioned by demigods.
However, Kent lied to them, smiling.
"You are a mysterious person, Kent," Vika muttered, a smile appearing on her face as she lay her head on Fallon’s shoulder.
"Ain’t no dragon like me, dear."
Inaya and Ainna became stunned when they overheard what he revealed.

"I knew he bought the broken sword for a reason, but to think it would be worth hundreds of trillions if they knew what it cantains. That part is unexpected," Ainna remarked, a bit regretful she hadn’t tried to bid for it.

"What are you even regretful about? It isn’t like he would keep it hidden forever. In the past, he wielded many legendary swords, and due to that, I was exposed to many mysteries of the sword world. If you stick around for a few years, I am sure you would be amazed by what he is capable of."
Ainna chuckled and turned to look at the stage, where another item was brought out for auction. It was a Tier 24 Pill.

"The next item is a Tier 24 Heaven Defying Pill. As you all know, with this pill, you can defy the heavens once in your life. Many use it to bypass bottlenecks, and some use it to bypass tribulations.
All in all, whatever you want to defy the heavens with, this pill can easily handle it. This one also has 4 Violet Pill Rings, raising its potency by 48 times."
Many sucked in a cold breath. However, when the starting bid was announced, they all let out weak smiles.
"We will start the bidding at 30 billion."
Kent sat and watched as people raised the bid from the initial 30 to 300 billion. He could only shake his head and wonder just why people had to spend this much money on a single pill.
In his head, this pill should have sold for less than 200 billion. While it is good and its use is heaven-defying, the pill ring composition was just too low.
Considering it is a Tier 24 pill, it should have at least two Crimson Pill Rings and four Violet Pill Rings. So in his mind, it was a failure, but a good failure.
Five more items were auctioned after that, until finally the auction reached the two items planned to end this session: the two spirit paintings.
Since Kent offered, Lady Annette chose the Seven Pattern Butterfly painting, so they would be auctioning the Dream Illusion Flower painting and the Demon Heart Gaze.
"We are finally down to our last two items. As you are all aware, the last two items are indeed the spirit paintings. I wouldn’t want to waste anyone’s time, so why don’t we get down to business."
The anticipation burned in the air as the first painting was revealed.

Considering it is a Tier 24 pill, it should have at least two Crimson Pill Rings and four Violet Pill Rings.
So in his mind, it was a failure, but a good failure.
Five more items were auctioned after that, until finally the auction reached the two items planned to end this session: the two spirit paintings.
Since Kent offered, Lady Annette chose the Seven Pattern Butterfly painting, so they would be auctioning the Dream Illusion Flower painting and the Demon Heart Gaze.
"We are finally down to our last two items.
As you are all aware, the last two items are indeed the spirit paintings.
I wouldn’t want to waste anyone’s time, so why don’t we get down to business."
The anticipation burned in the air as the first painting was revealed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1508: True Bidding War
paragraphs: The first painting to be auctioned was the Dream Illusion Flower.

"This painting is called Dream Illusion Flower. It is an illusion-based painting in which, by sending one’s consciousness inside, one would be plagued by one illusion after another, each more harrowing than the last.

The longer you can stay inside the illusion, the stronger your mind becomes. I have personally tested it, and while I may be a True God, I was able to only last 4 hours inside. That should tell you the terrifying capabilities of this spirit painting."
Everyone became stunned, not expecting to hear such praise from Lady Tilly. They were already aware that she only auctions off things with value.
She wouldn’t lie to sell something that had no value. So they could tell the painting was, as she said, something valuable.
Since that was the case, it made them wonder just who could create something this powerful.
"To be frank, I wanted to keep this painting for myself when it was brought over by our very own Lady Annette. However, she said the painter wanted it to be auctioned, so here we are.
I will place the starting bid at 100 billion. You can increase it by 1 billion. May the wealthiest bidder win."
"110 billion,"
"150 billion"
"210 billion"

The bidding started, and in under five seconds, it climbed past 200 billion. Kent, who was seated in VIP room 13, furrowed his brow, clearly not expecting Lady Tilly to place the starting bid at 100 billion.

From his memories, his best paintings sold for less than the starting bid set for today’s painting. Back then, while he didn’t have access to such an extravagant auction house like this, he had the chance to meet gods and immortals, and even then, the highest he had sold was 67 billion spirit stones.
So he was stunned that his painting was being sold for over 200 billion.
Shockingly, the bidding had only just begun. However, with dozens of people bidding, the price rose to 500 billion in no time.
The moment it moved past that price range, many started to drop out. The price kept increasing until only two bidders remained. By then, the price had already reached 700 billion.

The two bidders, both True Gods, kept going for another 20 minutes, taking the price all the way to 900 billion. It was then that a third voice entered the bidding war, causing the two True Gods to turn and look at VIP room 3.
"1.5 trillion."
Inaya took a sip of her wine, a smile playing on her face as she looked toward the two VIP rooms. They said nothing, but Kent could tell both True Gods were seething in anger.
They wasted a considerable amount of time fighting over something, only for a third party to swoop in and take it from them.
The price Inaya gave was just too much for a spirit painting. In fact, they initially planned to end the bidding war at 1 trillion. However, adding 500 billion to it was just too much for them.
In the end, Inaya won the bid at 1.5 trillion spirit stones. That is roughly 15 billion Spirit Crystals. Such wealth is enough to make anyone influential even in a god world.
After the Dream Illusion Flower painting was sold, Lady Tilly brought out the Demon Heart Gaze painting.
"This is our last item, so be sure to go out with a bang." Everyone took in a deep breath and waited for her to introduce the spirit painting.
"The painter named it the Demon Heart Gaze. And yes, it does exactly what the name suggests. It allows one to see if they have heart demons."
Murmurs spread across the auction house, some calling it bullshit while others wondered if there was such a thing as a spirit painting that could determine heart demons.
"Silence, everyone," Lady Tilly said, causing everyone to become quiet. She turned toward a door to her left, and a young lady walked out.

"When I received this painting from Lady Annette a few days ago, I was also skeptical of its use. So I did what anyone would do: I reached out to the Light Church, and they sent someone to confirm its authenticity.
This fine lady here is one of the patients being treated at the Light Church. She developed a heart demon from infancy after she witnessed the massacre of her entire family.
She had been at the Light Church almost all her life, but even they couldn’t find her heart demon—until recently."
Lady Tilly formed a hand seal and pointed it at the painting. The green eyes on it glowed, and then she gestured for the young lady to look into those eyes.
Under everyone’s stunned gaze, a roar came from the painting along with red smoke that manifested into a grotesque-looking monster.

Lady Tilly was quick to act, waving her hand to catch the monster. She then sealed it away and thanked the young lady, who, after 30,000 years, would finally be free of her heart demon once it was slain.
"Like I said, my auction house doesn’t auction fake treasures, so never doubt the authenticity of what we put out for bidding."
"Impossible. Just how can a spirit painting be this powerful?"
"A better question—who painted it?"
"Indeed. Who painted such a powerful treasure?"

Lady Tilly smiled. "I don’t know. However, they claim you will be seeing more of their paintings around soon. Also, since we are on that topic, I would like to appeal to the Nine Stars Chaos Brush to remember my auction house in the future when he has more paintings to auction off."
Many laughed, but a few started looking around, some wondering who among them was the Nine Stars Chaos Brush.
All the same, now that they had a name, they would keep a lookout for the Nine Stars Chaos Brush and hope that in the future, he would reveal more paintings to the universe.
"On that note, the starting bid is set at 100 billion again."
Kent smiled weakly, watching as the gods became hungry to have his painting.
"I never knew spirit paintings are this valuable," Vika muttered, looking at Kent.

Fallon smiled and answered, "Same here. While I have collected many paintings, none was valued this much. In fact, the most expensive painting I ever collected was 80 billion, and even that was because it was from another era."

"The world of Spirit Painting is vast, so there is no need to be stunned, ladies. Now that I have a Spirit Brush, I will paint more. Spirit paintings are a gift of nature, so the universe deserves to have more of them."
They nodded and continued to watch as the price climbed all the way to a trillion. Yet again, the same True Gods were the ones locked in the bidding war.
However, there were three others. This continued for an hour and a half before a True God inside VIP room 18 won the bid at a staggering 2.1 trillion spirit stones.

Kent smiled cheerfully, knowing he had made bank this time. He had purchases to make that even tower points couldn’t cover. So with this much money, when he ascended, even without his money still yet to be claimed, he could live comfortably.

chapters.title: Chapter 1509: End Of The Auction
paragraphs: The auction finally came to an end. Those who won bids smiled while the unlucky ones sighed and resigned themselves to their failures.
Lady Tilly Spoke:
"Thank you all for coming. While not all of us managed to win a bid, we showed the spirit of true buyers, limiting ourselves where we should.
Today is not the end. A year from now, we will hold another auction, so do well to stock up on some spirit stones, because when we meet again, it will be about who has the money and who doesn’t.
That said, those who won a bid should come to our offices to pay for their items and collect them." Lady Tilly paused and turned to VIP Room 13...
"Young man, you can come to my office so we can talk about how best to handle the map. I will send it to the Cult of Wisdom, but before that, we need to have a talk."
Kent nodded and turned to his ladies. "Wait for me here, I will be right back."
They nodded, and Kent walked away. A few minutes later, he stopped before a door where Lady Tilly was already waiting for him.
"Glad you are here. Let’s go inside and talk."
Kent followed her inside. After they settled down, she started to speak...

"First of all, care to introduce yourself and what connection you have with the Cult of Wisdom?" Lady Tilly asked, her expression calm. However, Kent could tell she was keeping a focused look on him, making sure he didn’t lie to her.
This made him smile. After keeping his breath from spiraling, he answered, revealing a part of the truth to her.

"About two years ago, I mistakenly solved a puzzle the cult of wisdom left on a planet called Manelaus. I didn’t know it was a test to select the next Wisdom Scroll, so you can say I accidentally became their next candidate.

They had been looking for me all this time. Initially, I wanted to run from them until everything was over. However, I was advised to go to them, since learning from them is much more valuable than I could learn anywhere else.
So you can tell them Chaos said hi and that they shouldn’t worry about finding me. I will be there for the Trial of Wisdom.
Of course, for now, you can call me Jaqen..."
Lady Tilly remained quiet for a few seconds before she nodded. "I will convey your message. That said, do you really think you can solve the map and discover the locations of the treasures?"
"Of course. Although I said it would take me 100 years, the truth is I can solve it in under 50 years. However, now I am a bit busy, so say in 100 years’ time, I will decipher it."

Lady Tilly smiled. "That is impressive, young man. Although I have no reason to believe you, since you said you can solve it, how about we do business? Once the coordinates have been deciphered, you can give a few to my auction house for auction.
After auctioning them off, we will take only 10% instead of the usual 15%. What do you think?"
Kent smiled and nodded. "I wouldn’t have done this if I hadn’t seen what your auction house is capable of. So, once I have deciphered it, I will give you half of the coordinates to auction.
That said, you can deposit my sales from today’s auction here. Be sure to deduct the purchase I made first."
Lady Tilly furrowed her brow, a bit at a loss for words. "What are you talking about?"
"The spirit paintings. I was the one who painted them. You can ask Lady Annette."
"WHAT?"
Lady Tilly exclaimed, quickly retrieving her communication jade token to make a call. A few seconds later, her eyes widened.
"You are the Nine Stars Chaos Brush."
"The one and only."

Gods are beings who have transcended the limits of mortality and even touched the Dao. Such people have seen it all, so for one to be shocked this way means the thing that shocked her is just beyond her comprehension.
"Just who are you,"
Kent laughed. "It is still too early to tell you, Lady Tilly. Of course, I am sure soon enough, you will come to learn more about me."
She remained in shock for a few more seconds before she managed to recover somehow. Kent then waved his hand, and two spirit paintings appeared.
"Because you managed to impress me, you can add these two to your auction line-up in the next auction. Hopefully, we will have more dealings in the future."
Lady Tilly nodded frantically and quickly stowed the paintings away. She then took Kent’s Universal Bank Jade and rushed out. "I will be back shortly."
Kent smirked.
If there is anyone who can shock a god, then he is that person. He had already lived long enough to know that when it comes to powerful treasures, people just lose their minds over them.
Twenty minutes later, she returned with the items Kent bought and the funds deposited on the jade token.
Kent had no idea how this bank jade works. He learned from Lady Wu that it was connected to a very powerful formation that regulates money transfers all over the vast universe.

She even said that regardless of the currency you want, as long as there is money on the token, it can be converted. This means that by depositing spirit stones, one can withdraw or pay with Spirit Crystals.
Kent kind of envied whoever had the brains to create such a powerful formation.
In the end, instead of carrying trillions in spirit stones around, he now has it on a small jade token.
"I will remain in touch, Lady Tilly."
"Pleasure doing business with you, Jaqen."
Kent nodded and left.
He met with his ladies, and soon, they left the auction house. He had already given three paintings to Lady Annette, who claimed she would use them to sell his name far and wide.
Kent wanted to simply send a message out there, hoping to reach his mother if she still lives. So, since Lady Annette claimed she could sell his name, he would allow her that courtesy.
He had already become aware of how valuable a spirit painting really is.
So, since that is the case, the more people know his name, the more valuable his future paintings will be. He has many ideas for painting, so for now he can only count on making his name known.
"Where to next?" Lene asked, hugging Kent’s arm like always. Since they had secured a deal with Lady Annette, they would finally be leaving Snow City tomorrow.
"Let’s go back to the shop. I want to examine the items I bought, especially the spirit brush. If I can even use it to paint one last painting before leaving, it will be great."
They nodded and started walking away from the auction house.
A few minutes after their departure, Kent stopped and looked around. "Something is not rig—"
"WATCH OUT!"
BOOM
A giant sword came from thin air, aimed right at Vika’s chest. Fallon was quick to pull her away, but the shockwave from the attack pushed all four of them away.

Kent shot through the air like a cannonball, slamming into a metallic statue 10 km away. When he rose back to his feet, he found himself staring at a 3-meter-tall brute oozing a very potent demigod aura.
"Who are you?" Kent asked, his expression dark.
"The one sent to kill you."
Before Kent could say another word, a powerful fist slammed into his chest, sending him flying thousands of miles away, blasting a hole through the city walls.

chapters.title: Chapter 1510: Fighting a Demigod
paragraphs: Everything happened so fast that before Kent and his ladies knew it, they were separated and faced off against demigods.

When the sword attack landed, Lene was also pushed back by the shockwave it generated. However, unlike Kent, who couldn’t handle the push, she stabilized herself quickly and tried to rush to Kent’s rescue.
However, just when she tapped into the connection they shared, it was severed by something far beyond her comprehension. It was instantaneous, something that threw her game upside down.
This prevented her from getting to Kent. So she could only watch as her master slammed into a metallic statue.
She clenched her fist and flew toward him, only for a demigod with ten swords hovering behind him to appear and block her path.
"You are not going anywhere, young lady," he said with a smirk.

"Move before I move you." Lene’s eyes turned green as waves of green hellfire burst from her body. A large bone-like bow appeared in her hand, and with one roar, a powerful shockwave spread all over the city.
She is someone who can use three weapons: a sword, a spear, and a bow. Today, she chose to wield the bow.
"Move."𝙧𝙚𝙚𝔀𝒆𝓫𝓷𝙤𝓿𝒆𝙡.𝒄𝙤𝓶
Lene wasted no time and attacked, causing the demigod to frown and also get serious. He could sense it deep within his bones that his opponent was not an easy target.
Lene was not someone he could joke around with like he initially expected.

Unfortunately for Lene, after clashing with the demigod for a few seconds, she knew her master would have to hold on for a few minutes. She tried to contact Vexthra and the others; however, she found that the connection had also been severed.
Painfully, even as she managed to push the demigod back, she saw Kent sent flying, slamming through thousands of buildings until his small body blasted a hole through the city wall.
Watching blood fly from his mouth as he was hurled away, she grew furious with her attacks. Unfortunately, she wasn’t having the upper hand she expected.
Meanwhile, Vika and Fallon were also pushed back by the shockwave. However, because Fallon grabbed Vika a moment before the attack aimed at her landed, they were pulled away to the same spot.

"Vika, oh Vika... Who would have thought you were the traitor all along," a lady demigod with two horns on her forehead said, walking toward the two of them just as they recovered and got back to their feet.
Vika said nothing but retrieved her daggers. Then, with a simple will, her clothes switched to her battle armor. She moved and stood before Fallon, shielding her from the demigod.
"Lord Hunter wants you brought in alive. However, an accident can happen, so rest in peace in advance."
She vanished, and a second later, appeared before Vika, stabbing a short sword at her.
However, while that attack was meant to kill, what happened next shook her.
Fallon appeared from behind Vika and deflected the attack, giving Vika the chance to strike with her leg.
Kent had always admired slender legs, so if he were present now, he would have admired how flexible Vika’s leg appeared when she lifted it, landing a powerful kick on the demigod’s face.
The impact threw her head backward, causing her senses to dull instantly.
Fallon used that opening to make a terrible move, one that instantly caused their side of the battle to erupt into a frenzy.
Just when the demigod became disoriented, Fallon exploded a poison pill right before her face, forcing her to inhale.
Vika pulled her away, just in time for the demigod to erupt into a frenzy, one that forced her to turn into her demi-beast form.
She took on the look of a demi-panther, her body rising by a few meters. In no time, she towered four meters above her opponents.
"Ghost Tactic," Fallon said, and Vika nodded. The next second, they split up and started running circles around their target. A few seconds later, Vika vanished, and Fallon made a run for it.
"Where do you think you are going?" the demigod lady exploded behind her, her speed closing the gap between them instantly.
However, just when she attacked, Fallon vanished and appeared 4 km away beside Vika. They only gave each other a look before they split up again and started running in opposite directions.
"AHHHHHH!"
The demigod screamed, her expression turning bitter. She looked between Fallon and Vika before choosing to run after Vika this time around.
Unfortunately for her, she only had one chance to kill them, and that was wasted when Fallon deflected her attack.

Now, she would have to push herself to the limit before, hopefully, she could gain another chance, or hope for Fallon to run out of energy, since as long as her innate ability was active, they would always be just out of reach.
Kent, on the other hand, was also battered and bruised after just two attacks. The first attack broke a few bones, but after the second, blood started to pour out from the injuries he had sustained.
He was sent flying out of the city. When he got back on his feet, he saw Lene had also appeared outside the city. The only ones still in the city were Fallon and Vika.
Just like Lene, he tried to call for help. However, he found that the connection between them had been severed.
This meant he would have to find another way to get out of this alive.
The demigod who punched him appeared 300 meters from him, a broad smile playing on his face. "The last thing you should have done was cross Lord Hunter. Now, you will have to die."
Kent wiped the blood off the corner of his lips and spat out the rest. He then narrowed his eyes and asked:
"Your name is Flint, right?"
The demigod frowned.

"No need to frown, Flint. You still have a chance to save yourself. You can turn around and leave right now, and I will let everything slide. If not, you can duel with me, and I will use everything at my disposal to escape.

But here is what will happen if you choose the latter. After I am gone, I will train hard and become strong enough to kill you with just one finger. But that won’t be the end. I will hunt down the one called Vicky and Maddon and kill them.

Then I will head to the Demon Continent and kill Vera and her daughter, Juliana. Afterwards, your parents living on Planet Grayden will also be killed, and their bodies will be left for the fish to devour."
Flint’s face paled, hearing all these names mentioned. He knew all of them, and considering the line of work he is in, he made sure they remained hidden from all.
So Kent, knowing all about them, came as a shock.
However, as if compelled by an external force, the paleness turned to anger, and before Kent knew it, he exploded forward, his fist blazing.
"Soul Explosion."
Kent moved, and in his place, thousands of soul spirits appeared, surrounding Flint. Before he could move, they exploded, sending out a powerful soul attack at the brute.
The attack was so powerful that it sent a shockwave far and wide, drawing the attention of thousands. They started appearing; some instantly recognized Kent from the auction.
Kent didn’t bother to look, since he knew the soul attack wasn’t enough to kill a demigod. However, it bought him time to attack again.

He extended his hand, and Gaap appeared, exuding a very powerful resentful Qi. Kent tapped into that resentment and channeled his sword aura into it, instantly causing a powerful sword aura to fill the space.
The demigod felt the change, so he charged forward. Kent also did, knowing all too well that the only way to escape was to gain some upper hand. And to do that, he must learn Flint’s battle style.
