chapters.title: Chapter 1511: Dangerous Battle
paragraphs: Kent knew he was in no way at the level where he could fight demigods. In fact, he wasn’t even ready to fight a real Immortal King.
So the fact that he charged toward such an existence was already shocking enough. However, he was somehow not getting smashed to a pulp, as one would expect.
If anything, he was holding his own against his opponent. While he was merely fighting an uphill battle, the fact that he hadn’t died just yet was very shocking.
All flame veins had been activated, so speed-wise, he wasn’t lacking much.
Thankfully, his opponent wasn’t someone who specialized in speed. He was a brute, so with the little speed Kent had, he was able to keep up with him.
Of course, with hundreds of gods watching, he didn’t dare bring out the Jade Void Wings. However, if push came to shove, he wouldn’t hesitate.
"Die, bug!"
Flint came at Kent with a deadly blow, aiming to smash him to bits. However, Kent moved his body just fast enough to let the fist brush past his chest and fly into the air.
Kent used the chance to distance himself.

With the soul map activated, he merely moved his body, and he was several kilometers away. This was helping him live just long enough to observe the battle happening between his ladies and the other demigods.
Somehow, Fallon and Vika managed to pull their opponent away from the city, where the vastness of the wild would enable them to play with her.
Their opponent was actually at a disadvantage.

As time slowly passed, she started to grow tired, a sign that she was being affected by the poison that Fallon had exploded in her face. However, that wasn’t a chance for them to relax. If anything, their opponent only seemed to grow stronger the more they stayed out of her reach.
Fallon’s innate ability remained active, so whenever they found themselves in danger, it teleported them to safety.

Lene, however, was holding her own against the demigod. Every arrow found its mark. However, a battle against a demigod with the intent to kill is different from looking for an opening to slip away and aid her master.
In short, Lene knew killing her opponent would take too much time, so she was only using half her focus on the battle while the other half looked for an opening to exploit and escape to Kent’s side.
However, whenever she found one, it closed the next second, almost as if her opponent knew what she intended to do and moved to block that opening.
Even more shocking was the fact that whenever he blocked an opening, it remained blocked forever. It shouldn’t have been the case, especially in a high-speed battle like this.
Judging by what Lene had observed so far, when an opening is blocked, another should open. However, that wasn’t happening. This made her wonder just what the hell was happening.
However, she soon realized that if she didn’t kill her opponent, getting to Kent would be extremely hard—almost impossible.
"Damn it," Lene cursed as one barrage after another rained on her opponent.
The longer the battle dragged on, the more attention it drew. Of course, whenever a spectator appeared, the battle that seemed to draw their attention was the one happening between Kent and Flint.
They had no idea how to describe a Heavenly Ascension-stage cultivator lasting 20 minutes against a demigod.
While he was injured in several places, Kent never seemed to slow down, even for a moment, which stunned them.
"There is a first time for everything, at least. Today, my eyes have been opened to see the impossible."
"Same here. If it wasn’t because these are people of Lord Hunter, I would have stepped in and saved this kid."
"Such a pity. He has some potential, too bad he had to die."
"I wonder what they did to Lord Hunter to force him into sending three demigods after them."
Just as the God King said that, Kent faltered, creating an opening in his airtight defense. This gave Flint an opportunity to land a killing blow.
Lightning filled the sky as he descended like a mountain.
Far in the distance, Ainna grinned, her expression filled with extreme happiness. "You can save him now," she said, knowing this fist would kill Kent regardless of what defense he mounted.
"I said—" she was about to repeat herself when she sensed something had changed in the air.
"NO!"
She tried to move her body; however, it was then that she realized why Inaya didn’t move when she gave her the go-ahead.
"I—I cannot move."
By then, Flint’s fist was only a meter from Kent’s chest.
"NOOOOOO!"
Her painful cry filled the air, despair shooting through her body. For a moment, she felt like her life had come to an end.
She tried to move her body, channeling all her supreme strength.
However, despite being a Supreme, she felt her body freeze. And it wasn’t just her; everyone present felt the same. The only people free were the combatants.
So with horror in her eyes, she could only watch as Flint moved closer, his fist aimed to kill.
Because she could not move her body, she could not see the look on Inaya’s face. However, she knew she had tears in her eyes because she also had tears in hers.
So she shut them, just so she wouldn’t see the death of the one person her friend had waited billions of years for die because of her.
BOOOOOOM
A powerful explosion rocked the battlefield, sending a shockwave through it. Ainna, her eyes still shut, felt the shockwave pass over her, causing her to stiffen.
She knew what she had never planned for had happened, and the only thing she could think about was how to face her friend.
She only wanted to punish Kent, but ended up killing him instead.
Slowly, she opened them. She was afraid, saddened, and guilty as her eyelids fluttered open.
However, the sight she expected didn’t materialize. Instead, her gaze landed on a large dragon holding Flint’s fist in its talons.
This sight stunned everyone. Nobody knew how it happened or even if it should be possible. However, Kent had indeed blocked the punch using his true beast form.
Then, under everyone’s stunned gaze, though still frozen, he unleashed a powerful push, sending Flint flying back.
ROAR
Kent let out a powerful roar, his voice spreading far and wide. He raised his head and looked up into the air, the look of disdain appearing in those predatory reddish gold dragon eyes.
"Are you going to keep hiding like a coward, or show your sorry self if you have the balls?"
Because the people around were frozen in place, they couldn’t look up. However, a few managed to use their divine senses to look higher.
It was then that they saw a red smoke appear in the clouds.
From within, a voice spoke, "Little dragon, you would do well to respect your elders."

"Elders, my foot. In my eyes, a Celestial who seeks to set someone like me up to fight a demigod is as useless as they come. Of course, only a loser such as yourself will find joy in the death of children.
But then again, what do I expect from a Soul Temple lapdog?"
Kent wasn’t even done when a terrible pressure descended on everyone. His colossal body was forced to the ground, every bone in his body breaking.
Cracks formed all over his colossal body, blood oozing from them.
Up ahead, hissing from the red smoke, a slim-looking old man with a hunchback appeared, holding a spiked spear. He descended and hovered a few meters off the ground.
"I was sent here to take you in alive. However, I now have a reason to kill you." He pointed his spear at Kent and let out a grin.
"That will be one less Spirit Painter."
A reddish ball of unknown energy formed at the tip of his spear, causing the energy crashing down on Kent to triple.

He was forced to transform back to his humanoid form to minimize the damage. However, with every bone in his body broken, blood pouring out from his injuries, nose, mouth, and ears, the only thing left for him was death.
"So long, kid."
The beam shot forward, and under everyone’s stunned gaze, it arrived before Kent in an instant.
However, just when the beam could land on him, a bald kid, not older than 13, appeared and caught it with his bare hand.
"You dare hurt Big Brother?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1512: The Bald Kid
paragraphs: One moment, Kent was at the point of death with no salvation in sight. Then, the next, a bald kid appeared from thin air, and the attack that could have killed Kent and even left a permanent crater was caught in one hand.
The strange part was that everyone recognized the bald kid at first glance. Naturally, nobody expected him to appear here today, especially to save a nobody like Kent.
As the corporeal form of the sword intent left behind by Lord Genesis, saving a mere Sword King was the last thing they expected.
After the attack failed, the old man from the Soul Temple distanced himself from Kent.

The kid ignored him and pointed his finger, causing the three demigods who had attacked Kent and his ladies to come to a sudden halt. Then, with a wave, all three of them were pulled toward him alongside Lene, Fallon, and Vika.
They rushed to Kent’s side, and Lene started healing him.
"Kill him," Kent said, barely holding on to his breath.
He tried hard to keep his consciousness active. However, he was beyond tired, so after issuing the order, he passed out, his consciousness drifting into a distant dreamland.
"Okay, big brother."

The kid narrowed his eyes at the old man, who felt a wave of dread fall on him. He pulled out a treasure and tried to use it to escape. However, just when he moved, a wave of sword energy so powerful he couldn’t describe fell on him, sending him crashing down to the ground.
At that time, the energy surrounding Inaya, Ainna, and the rest of the spectators was lifted.
Inaya tried to rush to Kent’s side. However, she slammed into an invisible wall.
"Nobody is allowed to get close to my big brother," the bald kid announced before turning toward the old man.
Inaya sighed, a wave of pain appearing in her eyes.
"Kid, let me go, or else you will invoke the wrath of the entire Soul Temple," the old man said.
He made a desperate attempt to earn his freedom, but it was futile.

Naturally, that was shocking considering he is a Celestial, yet he had to resort to begging to earn his freedom. Then again, the kid was someone who single-handedly defended this planet from all forms of danger across many eras with nothing more than his aura.
The old man is screwed.
The bald kid flashed a mocking smirk and muttered coldly: "I don’t care."
With a wave of his hand, a large sword appeared in the air and moved toward the old man, causing him to grit his teeth and slap the pouch hanging at his waist.
A round disc appeared.
Then, with a gentle tap on his forehead, he pulled out a blood essence. It landed on the disc, causing a powerful wave of energy to explode from his body.
"I will repay this humiliation a millionfold." His body shrank, and before the sword could land on him, he vanished into the disc. The void cracked, and the disc vanished into it.
The kid sighed and turned toward Kent. A second later, his gaze turned and locked onto Ainna.
Her body trembled. "Release him, or else you will die."
His small voice, while sweet, caused Ainna to panic. She knew what the kid was referring to, so upon hearing his command, she obeyed instantly.
With a wave of her hand, an artifact appeared in her hand. He pointed his finger at it, causing a circular array to appear around it. Then, with a wave, it dispersed.
Lene instantly felt her connection to the tower reestablished. She immediately reached out to Vexthra before she vanished into the tower along with Kent’s body.
Vika and Fallon followed.

The kid turned and looked at the three demigods. He snapped his finger, and a formation formed around them. Afterward, he looked at Ainna and Inaya. Before any of them could react, they vanished, appearing in a completely different place.
To make matters worse, they felt their energy suppressed to the level of the Heavenly Ascension stage.
The three demigods were rendered immobile. They were the attackers, after all. As for Inaya and Ainna, their bodies tensed, but they could move their limbs.
Meanwhile, inside the Harem Tower, Vexthra and her sisters appeared just when Lene and Kent also arrived.
"What happened?" Vexthra asked in a panicked voice.
"We were attacked, but three demigods and a Celestial."
"WHAT?"
The girls shouted in fright, Elaine rushing to Kent’s side.
Her hair turned green, sending a potent wave of healing energy through the air. She cast five healing spells in rapid succession, causing all color to drain from her face.
Kent’s body was bathed in the radiant energy of healing magic.
"Why didn’t you call us?" Miryssa asked.
"I tried, but something or someone severed the connection between us." Lene tried many times to call for help; however, every attempt failed thanks to Ainna’s artifact.
"Then how did you escape?" Lilian asked, using her own healing magic to heal the wounds that Vika had sustained.
"We didn’t escape. Just when the danger had reached its peak, a certain kid appeared and saved us."
As if right on cue, a bald-headed kid appeared from thin air, frightening everyone present. He ignored them and walked toward Kent’s body.
When he was close enough, he pressed his index finger on his forehead for a few seconds before a sigh escaped his lips.
"Relax, everyone. Big brother will be fine. He just needs a nap."
While they had no idea who this kid was, hearing his words made them breathe a sigh of relief. However, they still felt wary of him.
As if reading their minds, he smiled and said:

"I have brought the attackers here, so when you are done here, you can come question them." After saying that, he vanished and appeared inside the Legion Tower, where the three demigods, Inaya and Ainna, were being held.
"Big sister, do you know who that kid was to Kent?"
"I don’t; however, I think he is someone very dangerous. It would be best if we don’t antagonise him until Kent wakes up."
The ladies nodded.
"I will go see who dared to attack our man," Miryssa said before vanishing away. Some of the girls followed her, while the rest decided to help Vexthra take care of Kent first.

The outcome they expected didn’t happen. Instead, a Celestial appeared and was driven away with his tail tucked between his legs.
Those who were at the auction and recognized Kent wondered just what his background was. The fact that the sword intent left behind by Lord Genesis came to his rescue said everything.

Kent is no simple person. Some even said he might be related to Lord Genesis. While the man in question had been dead for billions of years, there is no reason to believe he hadn’t left a son or two behind.
The fact that his sword intent came to protect Kent made them believe so.
In the end, they could only wonder. After all, nobody could come up with a tangible reason why any of this happened.
However, they were left wondering who had informed the Soul Temple of the Spirit Painter’s presence. Also, while many had no idea Kent was the Spirit Painter, how then did they know Kent was the one?
This question made everyone start to suspect the one who put the paintings up for sale.
In the end, it was concluded that, until the Soul Temple points fingers at the one responsible—something that would never happen—all the blame and suspicion falls on Lady Annette.

chapters.title: Chapter 1513: Aftermath
paragraphs: A day quickly passed by on the outside. That is 24 days inside the tower.
A lot had happened since the battle between Kent’s team and the three demigods, which ultimately ended with a Celestial appearing only to be sent packing by a bald kid.
After the struggle, the first few hours saw many shift the blame for how Kent’s identity as the Spirit Painter was discovered by the soul temple to Lady Annette.
After all, she was the only one who saw Kent up close and also the one who put the painting up for the auction.
However, that was soon dispelled when Lady Tilly revealed the name of the one who leaked the information. It turned out she had suspected one of her workers of being an informant for the Soul Temple.

When Lady Annette came to her with the Spirit Paintings, she described Kent to her in vivid detail. As it happened, their conversation was overheard by this lady, prompting her to call the Soul Temple.
Unfortunately, the old man who nearly killed Kent was the closest to this planet, so he was sent to do the work that mostly requires immortal-stage agents.
The young lady tried to run, but she was captured and imprisoned. From what they had seen, keeping her alive for Kent would pacify his anger toward this planet.
As the only Spirit Painter to appear in millions of years, they all wanted to be in his good books. Naturally, his claim that he could decipher the cursed map only added to their overprotectiveness.
Some who wanted to speak up to him even went so far as to demand an answer from Lord Hunter, resulting in a battle that forced the poor god to run off the planet.
He left Planet Brymrr, and judging by how fast he ran, coming back would be very hard. But then again, he would soon become the hunted.
In less than a day, Kent’s influence had spread all over the planet.

Meanwhile, inside the tower, Vexthra and her sisters met Ainna and Inaya. Initially, Vexthra and her sisters were very angry when they learned that everything had started with Ainna wanting to punish Kent for what he had done to Inaya.

Vexthra, in particular, was very pissed. Before meeting Kent and her sisters, she was a no-nonsense kind of goddess. So her original self nearly awakened, had it not been for her sisters keeping her in check.
Eventually, she calmed down, and they finally learned the source of Ainna’s grievances.

While they didn’t have the complete picture of what had happened, given that their explanation was entirely from their perspective, they decided to accept their account for now and wait for Kent to wake up.
In a sense, after hearing what happened, they understood why she would go that far to get revenge.
Vexthra and her sisters, who knew why Kent went to look for Inaya in the first place, used that reason to calm down further.
They are aware that before Kent can deal with his heart demon, the forbidden seer who has part of his fate must be found. Unfortunately, she was imprisoned in Amon’s Guillotine Cave.

It is one of the seven Calamity Zones in the universe. This particular forbidden zone allows only swordsmen to enter. In the last 100 million years alone, millions of cultivators ventured in, and those who returned were fewer than a hundred.
In fact, some Supremes and Celestials who ventured in never returned.
Inaya was one of the few who managed to venture in there, spend a few thousand years, and return safely. Since that was the case, her help is needed.
So they softened their hatred for the two ladies who nearly caused the death of Kent and some of their sisters. If any of them had died, then they wouldn’t have been lenient on them.
After that, Vexthra had the three demigods thrown into the tower prison. They planned to give them to Yi Lai as potential dragon undead.
They must first pass the dragon ascension trial, of course, but with three of them, there is a chance one of them would at least make it.
For now, she must first become an Immortal before she can open the trial for such powerful beings.
They later decided to learn more about the bald kid, who, after returning to the Legion Tower, had closed his eyes and begun meditating.
They never got to ask him directly who he is or what he is, but thanks to Inaya knowing something about him, they learned he is a sword intent.
Naturally, every last one of them became stunned when they heard this. In their minds, there was just no way a sword intent should possess sentience, let alone become a living person.
However, Inaya explained that he isn’t the normal sword intent they knew.
She explained that the bald kid came into being as a result of Jest glimpsing into the realm above-the-sword Celestial (Sword Will) stage.
She had no name for it, but she believed Jest saw that next realm, and thanks to that, he was able to cultivate a few strands of that energy.
Learning that the bald kid had driven away a Celestial sure made them believe in Inaya.
It was only something far above the Celestial stage that could make a Celestial run with their tail tucked between their legs.
But if that was the case, then just what kind of existence was Kent (Jest) back then if a mere strand of his sword intent could do this?
This question, surprisingly, wasn’t one Inaya could answer. She said she parted ways with Jest when he reached the Sword Supreme stage.
Inaya said they parted ways, but Ainna said she was abandoned. Naturally, the feelings Inaya exuded when she spoke told them she had indeed been abandoned.
Again, when Kent awakens, everything will be cleared. Despite all that, as to how Kent cultivated that strand of sword intent, she had no idea.
Just that a few years after they went their separate ways, he gained enlightenment and started walking the path to the peak, just like how he planned to when he was still a slave.
He once looked up at the sky, his eyes grazing the Wall of Death, and shouted at the top of his voice, "I will one day escape this place and become the greatest swordsman to ever live."
He made that dream possible, but at the cost of losing someone very important in his life.
Now, Vexthra and her sisters decided to wait for Kent to wake up and explain himself before they headed back out there.
Kaizo and the others, who were left on the 11th floor, decided not to sit around doing nothing, so they made contact with the natives of that world.

Kaizo, being Kaizo, decided to use the chance to train, so he looked for their mission guild and registered. Even if they were there for a month, he wanted to use that time to train as much as possible.
As it happened, his new golem had made it possible for him to break past the Heavenly Ascension stage.𝙧𝙚𝙚𝔀𝒆𝓫𝓷𝙤𝓿𝒆𝙡.𝒄𝙤𝓶
So, in order to always be of strength when the need arises, he ventured into the wild with his golem and started dealing with the monster problem of the planet.
He aimed to become an Immortal before Vexthra returned. His golem is an Immortal King, so he had no reason to be afraid of anything while out there.
Some of the members in the Legion also found something to do while they waited for Vexthra and the rest of the girls to come back, so they could head to the 12th floor.
While all this was happening, Kent was also in the world of memories, recovering more of his memories as Jest, the Genesis Swordsman.

chapters.title: Chapter 1514: The Reason (1)
paragraphs: The last time Kent recalled his memories, it ended when Jest had reached the peak of the Sword Legend stage, and Inaya had finally found him after searching for thousands of years.
By then, she had already reached the peak of the Sword Immortal stage, and as the second person to have her name inscribed on the Sword Dao Tablet, she also had her fair share of troubles.
Back then, there were many swordsmen in the universe, some who had already reached the Sword Supreme stage.
Jest was a bit stunned when he learned that.
Before he ascended to the Immortal World, he had assumed that the peak was only at the Sword King stage. However, after he met the Sword Dao, that thought changed.
He became aware that there were more sword realms yet to be discovered by him. So he ascended when he reached the peak of swordsmanship in his world.
But he clearly never expected there to be Sword Supremes alive.
Due to this revelation, he knew why he and Inaya were kind of a big deal to everyone.
For two no-names to suddenly become recognized by a tablet that descended straight from the Sword Dao, every last swordsman wants to learn more about them.
Every swordsman back then wanted them captured and interrogated to spill the beans. However, despite their strength and danger, they managed to remain alive until they finally met.
It turned out Inaya was being hunted down by a rather vengeful Sword God whom she couldn’t contend against, and so she needed Jest’s help.
When they met, it was a short-lived reunion until they were forced to run again.
Jest may have been a monster back then, but even he was nothing compared to a Sword God. So they ran, and for thousands of years, they kept running.
Eventually, they ended back at the Whispering Wind Sect, where it all began.
While on the run, they heard the Sword God after them had attacked the sect, and so they returned to face him, knowing full well there was a chance they wouldn’t walk out alive.
The thousands of years they spent together running saw Jest try many times to become a Sword Immortal, but he failed each time.
Later, he realized why.
It turned out he had yet to conquer the last level of the Sword Bridge, which he had challenged quite a few times before leaving the sect.
He always wanted to conquer all floors one day. However, that never happened, which in a way created a setback for him.

That setback had held him back from reaching the sword immortal stage, so returning to the sect was a gamble, one where he must succeed at defeating the 13th level of the Sword Bridge and break through to the Sword Immortal stage before Inaya ran out of ways to hold back the sword god.
It was the closest both of them came to dying. However, in the end, Jest succeeded, and so after he became a Sword Immortal, the Sword God was pushed back until he had no choice but to run.
But who is Jest if not a vengeful bastard?

From the day Inaya’s clone chased him down, nearly killing him a few times, he had developed this vengeful heart, one that always made him become vengeful against people who tried to use their strength to suppress him.
This was why, after he saved the sect, he decided to get revenge. Obviously, Inaya followed him, and that was when their names started to spread again.
This time, instead of running, they were the ones doing the chasing.

The thousands of years they had spent running were being paid back, and so for thousands of years, they hunted down every last person who came against them and slaughtered them all, making new enemies along the way.
Their revenge lasted for 100,000 years. Along the way, Inaya became a Sword God while her cultivation was still at the Demigod stage.
When Jest finally also became a Sword God and, eventually, they both reached the rank of gods, a threat that aimed to devour the universe descended upon everyone.
With the threat of the foreign race looming, they were forced to abandon their plan for revenge and prepare for the battle that would determine the fate of the universe.
And so they entered seclusion, and for another 300,000 years, they trained very hard. Jest ended up reaching the Sword Supreme stage first, and with his guidance, Inaya did as well.
Back then, the Sword Supreme stage was the peak in the universe. However, Jest knew there was one more stage, the Sword Celestial stage.
His reasoning was rather simple. Since back then there were Celestials, he believed there must also be a Sword Celestial.
Many argued that the realms of sword cultivation were different from true cultivation, so measuring that against true cultivation was just him being overly ambitious.

However, Jest stood by his word and vowed to prove everyone wrong. He made them a promise that he would rise to that level and prove to everyone that there was indeed a rank above the Sword Supreme stage.
Of course, even he didn’t know how to reach it. So he and Inaya set that pursuit aside for the time being and began fighting back against the foreign race.
In no time, they were named the Blood Sword Couple.
They were given this name simply because of the kind of slaughter the two of them committed whenever they appeared on the battlefield.
In no time, thanks to their combined effort, the first wave of the foreign race was eradicated, giving the universe a chance to recover and prepare for the second wave.
It wouldn’t be for another million years before they returned, so Jest and Inaya decided to look for a way to reach the Sword Celestial stage.
After searching for 400,000 years without finding anything, Inaya decided to go back home to prepare for the second wave of the foreign race.
Another reason why she returned home was that she had finally managed to win Jest’s affection after spending millions of years together.
Of course, she hadn’t crossed the line with Jest yet; however, she knew the connection that had formed between them was love.
She felt it, and Jest also did.
While the brat was a bit rigid at first, they managed to discover the budding love that had ignited between them after spending over a million years together.
So she returned to her homeworld to prepare a home for them to start a family, while Jest followed the last lead he had discovered, believing it would lead to the last stage of true swordsmanship.
She knew Jest’s love for swordsmanship was undisputed, so she didn’t force him to come with her. Instead, she came home, and for the first time, she put her sword down.
In her heart, she would soon be the mother of Jest’s children, something she looked forward to. However, even after waiting for thousands of years, Jest never returned.
Later, she found out that Jest was running around with another woman.
This betrayal shattered her heart, and as someone who had cultivated the Ten Emotion Sword Dao, she felt its impact on her Love Dao, crippling her potential at the Sword Supreme stage.
To make matters even worse, the heartbreak developed into a heart demon, permanently keeping her at the Universal God stage.

Overnight, she went from someone with limitless potential to someone who would never reach the peak she had promised her dying sister, or become a family person like she had promised her dying mother.
The grandkids she promised to give her went out the window when the man she loved with all her heart betrayed her, leaving her for another woman.
This heartbreak shattered her mind, leaving her depressed for hundreds of thousands of years.

But he clearly never expected there to be Sword Supremes alive.
Due to this revelation, he knew why he and Inaya were kind of a big deal to everyone.
For two no-names to suddenly become recognized by a tablet that descended straight from the Sword Dao, every last swordsman wants to learn more about them.
Every swordsman back then wanted them captured and interrogated to spill the beans.
However, despite their strength and danger, they managed to remain alive until they finally met.
It turned out Inaya was being hunted down by a rather vengeful Sword God whom she couldn’t contend against, and so she needed Jest’s help.
When they met, it was a short-lived reunion until they were forced to run again.
Jest may have been a monster back then, but even he was nothing compared to a Sword God.
So they ran, and for thousands of years, they kept running.
Eventually, they ended back at the Whispering Wind Sect, where it all began.
While on the run, they heard the Sword God after them had attacked the sect, and so they returned to face him, knowing full well there was a chance they wouldn’t walk out alive.
The thousands of years they spent together running saw Jest try many times to become a Sword Immortal, but he failed each time.
Later, he realized why.
It turned out he had yet to conquer the last level of the Sword Bridge, which he had challenged quite a few times before leaving the sect.
He always wanted to conquer all floors one day.
However, that never happened, which in a way created a setback for him.

That setback had held him back from reaching the sword immortal stage, so returning to the sect was a gamble, one where he must succeed at defeating the 13th level of the Sword Bridge and break through to the Sword Immortal stage before Inaya ran out of ways to hold back the sword god.
It was the closest both of them came to dying.
However, in the end, Jest succeeded, and so after he became a Sword Immortal, the Sword God was pushed back until he had no choice but to run.
But who is Jest if not a vengeful bastard?

From the day Inaya’s clone chased him down, nearly killing him a few times, he had developed this vengeful heart, one that always made him become vengeful against people who tried to use their strength to suppress him.
This was why, after he saved the sect, he decided to get revenge.
Obviously, Inaya followed him, and that was when their names started to spread again.
This time, instead of running, they were the ones doing the chasing.

The thousands of years they had spent running were being paid back, and so for thousands of years, they hunted down every last person who came against them and slaughtered them all, making new enemies along the way.
Their revenge lasted for 100,000 years.
Along the way, Inaya became a Sword God while her cultivation was still at the Demigod stage.
When Jest finally also became a Sword God and, eventually, they both reached the rank of gods, a threat that aimed to devour the universe descended upon everyone.
With the threat of the foreign race looming, they were forced to abandon their plan for revenge and prepare for the battle that would determine the fate of the universe.
And so they entered seclusion, and for another 300,000 years, they trained very hard.
Jest ended up reaching the Sword Supreme stage first, and with his guidance, Inaya did as well.
Back then, the Sword Supreme stage was the peak in the universe.
However, Jest knew there was one more stage, the Sword Celestial stage.
His reasoning was rather simple.
Since back then there were Celestials, he believed there must also be a Sword Celestial.
Many argued that the realms of sword cultivation were different from true cultivation, so measuring that against true cultivation was just him being overly ambitious.
However, Jest stood by his word and vowed to prove everyone wrong.
He made them a promise that he would rise to that level and prove to everyone that there was indeed a rank above the Sword Supreme stage.
Of course, even he didn’t know how to reach it.
So he and Inaya set that pursuit aside for the time being and began fighting back against the foreign race.
In no time, they were named the Blood Sword Couple.
They were given this name simply because of the kind of slaughter the two of them committed whenever they appeared on the battlefield.
In no time, thanks to their combined effort, the first wave of the foreign race was eradicated, giving the universe a chance to recover and prepare for the second wave.
It wouldn’t be for another million years before they returned, so Jest and Inaya decided to look for a way to reach the Sword Celestial stage.
After searching for 400,000 years without finding anything, Inaya decided to go back home to prepare for the second wave of the foreign race.
Another reason why she returned home was that she had finally managed to win Jest’s affection after spending millions of years together.
Of course, she hadn’t crossed the line with Jest yet; however, she knew the connection that had formed between them was love.
She felt it, and Jest also did.
While the brat was a bit rigid at first, they managed to discover the budding love that had ignited between them after spending over a million years together.
So she returned to her homeworld to prepare a home for them to start a family, while Jest followed the last lead he had discovered, believing it would lead to the last stage of true swordsmanship.
She knew Jest’s love for swordsmanship was undisputed, so she didn’t force him to come with her.
Instead, she came home, and for the first time, she put her sword down.
In her heart, she would soon be the mother of Jest’s children, something she looked forward to.
However, even after waiting for thousands of years, Jest never returned.
Later, she found out that Jest was running around with another woman.
This betrayal shattered her heart, and as someone who had cultivated the Ten Emotion Sword Dao, she felt its impact on her Love Dao, crippling her potential at the Sword Supreme stage.
To make matters even worse, the heartbreak developed into a heart demon, permanently keeping her at the Universal God stage.

Overnight, she went from someone with limitless potential to someone who would never reach the peak she had promised her dying sister, or become a family person like she had promised her dying mother.
The grandkids she promised to give her went out the window when the man she loved with all her heart betrayed her, leaving her for another woman.
This heartbreak shattered her mind, leaving her depressed for hundreds of thousands of years.

chapters.title: Chapter 1515: The Reason (2)
paragraphs: [What Truly Happened - A few years after parting ways]
Jest had just returned from the final lead he got from an anonymous source, believing it would help him reach the sword celestial stage.
It turned out the lead led nowhere, so with the promise he made to Inaya, he decided to go back home and make a family with her.
It pained him that he couldn’t find a way to reach the Sword Celestial stage. However, with him doing everything he could, he knew he had no regrets now.
He had a beautiful goddess waiting for him back home, so that was something to be happy about.
Nothing, however, prepared him for who he met just when he was nearing Planet Genesis.
Before this encounter, Jest had heard stories of a being who lived in the starry skies. They claimed she was an existence even Celestials feared.
They called her the Horror of the Stars. He had heard stories about her, but he always felt they were a bit exaggerated. However, when he met her, he was inclined to believe those stories.
[Jest’s POV]
Jest was seated in a flying treasure, speeding toward the planet where Inaya was waiting for him. As he looked at the stars in the sky, a look of anticipation could be seen in his eyes.
"Inaya is going to kill me if I don’t hurry. Knowing how crazy she is, I’d better hurry." He channeled more energy into the ship, causing it to fly much faster.
However, just when he passed by a meteorite, the void exploded open, and a lady with long, red, entangled hair appeared, attacking him without any warning.
Jest jumped from his flying ship just as the spear hurled by the redhead blasted through it, shattering it completely.

A sword appeared in his hand just in time for him to deflect a second attack. However, before he could make sense of anything, a third and fourth attacks arrived before him, causing a wave of panic to set in.
"A Celestial, huh?" he muttered, channeling a wave of supreme sword aura into his sword. He was only a Supreme, but not an ordinary one, so he didn’t panic.
He relaxed his nerve and channeled more aura into his sword.
Then, with one quick slash, thousands of swords manifested into being and started to rain down on the lady. The blinding flashes and the chilling intent in the air made the void crack and shatter.
Even a Supreme Celestial would have to be careful against such an attack.
Jest expected her to slow down, considering every last sword was imbued with Sword Supreme sword intent, but she merely formed a dome around her and started attacking him.
Soon, a day passed, but none of them seemed to be slowing down. Jest was particularly surprised by how fiercely the lady fought.
It was through this ordeal that he realized the Horror of the Stars people talked about did exist, and that she was much crazier than they claimed.
However, she had to die.
After three days of intense battle, Jest finally saw it.
The only way he could get to Inaya was if this lady died. However, thinking of her death and actually doing it were two different things.
Killing her is impossible, in the short term. It would take time to get that chance.
However, he knew he had to kill her, and so he continued to clash with her, one deadly attack after another. Soon, a month passed, but the winner was far from sight.
Jest had adapted to 50% of the Horror of the Stars’ battle style. However, the longer the battle dragged on, the more he felt like he was drowning in a scheme he just couldn’t place his finger on.
Five months into the battle, Jest finally found an opening, and so he went for it.
"Genesis Sword Art - First form: Life and Death Slash,"
A deadly sword arc was carved into existence, creating a deep red line that streaked across the sky, cutting through asteroids like tofu before slamming into the crazy redhead’s body.
The impact was deadly.

Her left arm was severed, and a large wound was carved into her chest. Jest used the chance to get close and deal a deathly blow. However, just when his sword was inches away from piercing her heart, he felt it.
"AARRRRGGGHHH!"

A painful cry tore from Jest’s mouth, blood oozing from both his eyes and mouth. The attack that could have killed the lady was abandoned simply because his mind was taken over by something extremely deadly and painful.
Even more chilling, for the first time in five months, the crazy redheaded lady finally spoke...
"How does it feel, bastard? Are you in pain? Do you regret your life choices? Are you finally feeling what I felt when you killed my sister?"
Jest groaned, clenching his head. "Bitch, what the fuck are you talking about, and what the hell did you do to me?"
"What am I talking about?" She flung her head back and let out a mocking laugh.
"So you don’t remember. You don’t remember lying to my sister, deceiving her to follow you, only to kill her and leave her body for the dogs to feed on.

She trusted you, believed in you, but in the end, you betrayed her, causing her death. Now, I will make you feel how you made me feel back then. The best part is, since you don’t remember, I will have the privilege of showing you what will happen to you."
A ball of red energy appeared on her palm, oozing a malicious aura. With a wave, it flew into Jest’s forehead. At once, visions of what hadn’t happened yet filled his mind.
Inside the memories, he saw himself return to Inaya’s side, and just as they had planned, they started a family. He had two children, a boy and a girl. They named the boy Kent and the girl Artemis.
He saw them grow, with both taking after them. In no time, they became adults and potential powerhouses of the universe.
However, one fateful day, he woke up expecting it to be lively and full of joy, as always. But he was instead greeted with bloody hands and the headless bodies of his wife and two children.
This sight caused Jest to let out a painful cry, one that shook the very fabric of the universe.
"That is right. Scream, because that is the only thing you can do."
A tear fell from Jest’s eye as he gazed furiously at the lady. "What do you want from me?"
"Nothing. I just want to see despair in your eyes when I tell you this. I am now your heart demon. I cannot be killed, and I most certainly will not harm you in any way.

However, I will remain in your heart and wait for you to make a happy family. I will watch them grow, and just when you are at the peak of happiness, I will take over and kill them with your own two hands.
I will make sure they suffer and die hating you. Only then will I be satisfied."
Jest gritted his teeth, his tears flowing. He could feel it deep within his soul. He had indeed developed a heart demon, and so he knew what he saw had a possibility of coming to pass.

He would have a happy family and be blessed with the greatest joy in the universe. However, one day, even if he guarded against it, his heart demon would awaken, and he would slaughter his own family without any resistance.
He saw it, and he could feel deep within that it would happen. He didn’t know how, but he knew it would happen.
His mind spun frantically, searching for a solution. However, even after an hour, he found none. So he went ahead and played the second vision.

chapters.title: Chapter 1516: The Decision
paragraphs: The second vision saw Jest choosing to abandon Inaya for her own protection. Of course, he knew that decision would break her. However, knowing she would live at least made him choose that path.
In the end, he turned and left, leaving Inaya behind.
She, of course, had no idea the person she was waiting for had decided to leave her for her own safety.
She waited for him on Planet Genesis for a few thousand years. Soon, she found out Jest had abandoned her and was seen running around with another lady.
In truth, after he left, he started looking for ways to return to her. However, no matter how hard he looked, he found no viable path to living happily ever after.
The vision persisted, and the feeling inside his heart remained the same.
Even more heartbreaking, a few thousand years after he chose to leave, he discovered that because he still loved her, Inaya was somehow affected by him.
This led to her developing a heart demon of her own. And to make it even more chilling, because Inaya still loved him, her heart demon affected her cultivation, threatening to kill her.
The vision ended with Inaya actually dying when she tried to ascend to the Supreme stage. Jest tried to intervene when she found herself in mortal danger, but ended up causing her death instead.
"Just what do you want? Say it, and I will willingly do it if you promise to spare Inaya’s life."

"And why should I do that?" the redhead asked, her mocking expression turning even more demonic. "I exist only to make your life miserable, so what makes you think letting her live will aid me in achieving my goal?"

"She has done nothing to you. You are here for me, so let her go." Jest took a deep breath and exhaled before adding, "Even if you want me to become your slave, I will, as long as Inaya is left alone."
For someone who had fought to earn his freedom, promising to again become a slave was the hardest decision he could ever make.
Clearly, he really meant to preserve Inaya’s life no matter the cost.

"Very noble of you. However, as I said, I am now your heart demon, so regardless of what you offer, I will achieve my goal. You can kill me now and think that will be all; however, we both know it wouldn’t end there.

In short, as long as you are alive, she will never be safe. So you only have one choice, and that is to kill yourself. As long as you are dead, I will cease to exist, which will guarantee her safety."
Jest gritted his teeth, blood oozing from his gums. The decision he had to make now would not only determine the fate of the universe but also determine Inaya’s life.
If he killed himself, Inaya would indeed live. However, if the foreign race were to descend, there was a chance she would die along with thousands of others.
He wouldn’t be there to save her. So basically, he could not die.
However, if he chose to live, there was a chance Inaya would end up dying because of him. That was also unacceptable. However, he knew that was the only path ahead.
He could not go to her and live happily ever after to the bitter end.
He also could not kill himself and leave the universe unprotected.
Lastly, choosing to live but running the risk of causing Inaya’s death was also a bad move. In the end, there was no path ahead.
So Jest chose to make one. He rose to his feet and pointed his sword at the redhead. "You won, lady. This is your win. However, know this, one day, I will get rid of you for good."
Without waiting for her to say anything, Jest moved and severed her head from her body. His chest tightened, and before he could raise a mental defense, the pain descended, knocking him unconscious.

He was left to drift in space for roughly 200 years. While unconscious, he had many dreams, most of which featured him as a father and a happy husband. However, at the end of every dream, it turned into a nightmare.
The dream always ended with him killing his own family.𝕗𝐫𝐞𝕖𝕨𝐞𝗯𝚗𝕠𝘃𝐞𝚕.𝐜𝗼𝚖
These nightmares plagued him repeatedly for the duration of his sleep. When he woke up, his mind became numb to all kinds of pain.
He returned to Planet Genesis; however, he didn’t approach Inaya. He watched her from a distance for 30 good days before he left, never to return again.
First, he planned to sever Inaya’s feelings for him, since he could never stop loving her. He knew Inaya cultivated the Ten Emotion Sword Dao, and one of those emotions was Hatred.
If he could find a way to invoke that emotion, there was a chance she would stop loving him and instead hate him.

If that were to happen, she might develop a heart demon, but she wouldn’t die from it. In the vision, he saw Inaya try to become a Supreme simply because she wanted to become strong enough to search for him.
Be that as it may, while she was still heartbroken, a part of her kept telling her Jest wouldn’t abandon her without a tangible reason.
So she wanted to become strong to help him figure things out. However, that decision cost her her life. So, Jest sought to prevent that.
With her Dao of Hatred, she could become his greatest hater overnight. Jest only planned to end his life when the foreign race invaded fully this time.
He wanted to fight to the bitter end, so if Inaya were to hate him just long enough, he would die, leaving her with no leash hanging over her head.
In the end, Jest did the unthinkable. He sought out Inaya’s greatest enemy, and they began moving together, just as they had back when they were known as the Blood Sword Couple.
This decision had the effect he wanted. When she found out, she became furious, and while she tried hard against it, her hatred flared, severing the string of death over her head.
Jest succeeded, but at the cost of losing her forever. Thousands of years passed, and he never found a way to rid himself of his heart demon.

So he returned to his pursuit of the realm above the Supreme stage. Thousands of years later, he found a lead that led him to come face-to-face with an existence that would one day determine the fate of the entire universe.

100,000 years before the foreign race invaded, he took the next step, becoming the first Sword Celestial ever. And as he had promised, he shared the secret with everyone, hoping to see more powerful swordsmen rising alongside him.
10,000 years before the invasion, something even bigger happened. Jest gained another enlightenment, one that showed him a glimpse into the next realm.
When he saw this, he took 5,000 years to comprehend it. In the end, he succeeded in comprehending a new form of sword intent, which he called Eternal Sword Intent.
He formed seven Eternal Sword Intents and left them in seven different places to grow and one day become the doorway to the true peak he had glimpsed.
When the foreign race invaded, he fought with all he had. In the end, he died taking down the last threat that threatened Inaya and the universe at large.

In the vision, he saw Inaya try to become a Supreme simply because she wanted to become strong enough to search for him.
Be that as it may, while she was still heartbroken, a part of her kept telling her Jest wouldn’t abandon her without a tangible reason.
So she wanted to become strong to help him figure things out.
However, that decision cost her her life.
So, Jest sought to prevent that.
With her Dao of Hatred, she could become his greatest hater overnight.
Jest only planned to end his life when the foreign race invaded fully this time.
He wanted to fight to the bitter end, so if Inaya were to hate him just long enough, he would die, leaving her with no leash hanging over her head.
In the end, Jest did the unthinkable.
He sought out Inaya’s greatest enemy, and they began moving together, just as they had back when they were known as the Blood Sword Couple.
This decision had the effect he wanted.
When she found out, she became furious, and while she tried hard against it, her hatred flared, severing the string of death over her head.
Jest succeeded, but at the cost of losing her forever.
Thousands of years passed, and he never found a way to rid himself of his heart demon.
So he returned to his pursuit of the realm above the Supreme stage.
Thousands of years later, he found a lead that led him to come face-to-face with an existence that would one day determine the fate of the entire universe.
100,000 years before the foreign race invaded, he took the next step, becoming the first Sword Celestial ever.
And as he had promised, he shared the secret with everyone, hoping to see more powerful swordsmen rising alongside him.
10,000 years before the invasion, something even bigger happened.
Jest gained another enlightenment, one that showed him a glimpse into the next realm.
When he saw this, he took 5,000 years to comprehend it.
In the end, he succeeded in comprehending a new form of sword intent, which he called Eternal Sword Intent.
He formed seven Eternal Sword Intents and left them in seven different places to grow and one day become the doorway to the true peak he had glimpsed.
When the foreign race invaded, he fought with all he had.
In the end, he died taking down the last threat that threatened Inaya and the universe at large.

chapters.title: Chapter 1517: Sword Emperor
paragraphs: Kent didn’t know how long had passed. However, when he opened his eyes again, he saw himself in the harem tower, lying comfortably on the love bed.
Immediately, he knew what was about to happen, so he teleported and appeared inside the sword tower just in time for a powerful sword energy to explode out of his body.
In that instant, he sensed the very air around him had become razor-sharp, almost as if the air had turned into countless tiny swords.
It felt rather overwhelming and a bit chilling, considering the energy in the air is merely Heavenly sword energy.
He is still one step away from unlocking Divine sword energy. So, for heavenly sword energy to be this powerful, one can only wonder just what kind of monstrous talent Kent has.

As the minutes passed, the feeling grew sharper and sharper until it ended three days later. Once that ended, Kent sighed, and then he started what he had been waiting for from the very moment he started recalling Jest memories.
He commenced the formation and awakening of his sword realm. The moment he began, a raging sea emerged, filling the sword tower.
If one looks from a higher perspective, they would see water raging like a storm. However, in reality, it was countless swords fused so closely together that they appeared like a sea.

It was the sword realm that once made Jest the most dangerous swordsman to ever live. Unlike many swordsmen whose conceptual sword-realm frameworks manifested as a static realm, his was forged purely from his sword energy.
This means that what appears to be water is, in reality, his sword energy. Every last sword was his sword energy manifested into a realm.
This was why, as he grew stronger, his sword realm continued to expand, be reshaped, and augmented over and over again.
Also, since his sword realm came into being through his sword energy, the stronger he becomes, the more dangerous it becomes.
Basically, as he learned new things, he could continue to transform his sword realm.
There was no limit to what he could do with it.
So watching as his sword realm came into being yet again made him smile.
The sea continued to surge for a couple of hours before it subsided.
It was then that Kent breathed a sigh of relief.
With his sword realm awakened successfully, he could finally beat his chest and say he was ready for whatever would come against him.
He may not be a sword Celestial yet, but he has that knowledge, so he is as dangerous as they come.
"Tower, tell me we all made it out alive." The last thing he remembered was telling a certain bald kid to kill the Celestial who attacked him.
Since he was with Lene, Fallon, and Vika, he had to ask.
Thankfully, Tower’s response put his mind at ease. He had also just recovered all of Jest’s memories, and what he saw finally told him what he needed to know.
His hatred for Inaya was completely washed away. In his memories, he saw the impossible decision he had to make and the pain that decision had caused.
However, now that he had recalled his memories, learning that Inaya was still alive made him very happy. That was the outcome he wanted, and seeing it come to pass made him feel at peace.
However, with his memories recalled in full, he finally discovered just how harrowing his heart demon really was.
The crazy redhead was Dia’s incarnation. Believing Chaos was the cause of Artemis’ death led her to hate him until her hatred for him turned into his curse.

During the primordial era, she promised to follow him for all eternity. She indeed meant that, and after seeing what she was capable of, Kent believed that in this life, he wouldn’t let her have the upper hand.
Already, he managed to locate Dia early, so if Inaya could help him get Safira back from Amon’s Guillotine Cave, the decision he had to make in the past wouldn’t be repeated in this life, too.
"Tower, how long was I out for?"
[The master was out for two months outside of time.]
"That is roughly three years of tower time." Kent sighed and pulled up the system interface to read the messages he had received.
[Congratulations, you are now a Sword Emperor.]
[Congratulations, you have successfully awakened your sword realm.]
[Because of how deep your understanding of sword energy is, you have awakened True Heavenly Sword Energy.]
[You have unlocked a new sword skill: Heaven Sword Shower.]
[Heaven Sword Shower]
[Rank: Supreme]
[Description: You can form countless swords using sword aura and imbue them with sword intent. Every sword imbued with sword intent will have a 10,000% increase in damage output.]
Kent grinned wildly, "This is better than any of the sword techniques I have used in the past."
Already, his sword realm allows him to transform sword energy into real swords. Now, he will not only be able to form the swords, but each will also have a 10,000% increase in damage output.
That, added to the fact that he can exert his will in his sword realm, made it so much more powerful.
"I will have so much fun with this skill," he said as he moved ahead with scrolling through the messages he had received.
Most of them had to do with achieving what many swordsmen dreamt of.
True Sword Energy.
Because he was only at the Sword Emperor stage, he only had access to Heavenly Sword Energy. However, with him ascending to True Heavenly Sword Energy, there was just no telling what he could do.
He had not reached the stage where, with just his sword energy alone, he could do more damage without having to activate his other techniques.
Kent proceeded to review the requirements he needed to meet before he could ascend to the sword divine stage.
[Requirements to become a sword divine]
↠ Attain Absolute Heavenly Sword Energy
↠ Kill the Crimson Blood Demon General
Kent narrowed his eyes at the two requirements.

The first was something he had heard about but had never achieved. Back when he attained True Sword Energy, he learned that there is another realm beyond that called Absolute. However, neither he nor anybody he had ever met managed to achieve that.
In fact, he never believed there to be something like that until he glimpsed the realm above the sword celestial stage. That was when he believed it.
But even so, he could not attain that until his last breath. Now, before he could attain the sword divine stage, he must first touch that realm.
While he loves a good challenge, being asked to do something he did not know how to start was a bit more than he could handle.
As for the second challenge, he would have to meet the person he had to kill before he could decide whether or not he had what it takes to kill them.
"This is merely a challenge. I will handle it with ease, and when the time comes, I will handle this demon general like he were a bug," Kent laughed and stood up.
He knew nothing came easy, but for now, with his memories of Jest fully recovered, he not only had the knowledge but also the experience to back it up.

He had seen thousands of battles that Jest had fought and experienced every crashing moment of them. So it was safe to say he was now on the same level of experience as the greatest swordsman to ever live.
The only limiting factor was the fact that he had a much weaker body. His body was akin to a True Immortal. While that was good enough, he could not perform some maneuvers that the old Jest could.
"Ah, what am I even worried about? At the end of the day, it is all about how much better I am and how much weaker my opponent is." He sighed one more time and decided to go see his wives.
But first, he returned to the harem tower to freshen up.

chapters.title: Chapter 1518: Bittersweet Reunion
paragraphs: It took Kent less than ten minutes to freshen up and change into comfortable attire. Afterward, he decided to go see his wives and plan his next move.
When he asked the Tower if Lene, Fallon, and Vika were safe, she said yes. That was all he needed to hear. Next, he wanted to meet his wives before returning to Planet Brymrr to resume his mission.
With his memories fully recovered, he is now more motivated to find Inaya. As for the demigods, he will be taking Miryssa along. So he is ready to return to his mission.
Nothing, however, prepared him for what was waiting for him in the Legion Tower.
As if by design, when he appeared in the Legion Tower, the first person his gaze landed on was none other than the same person he went to Planet Brymrr for in the first place.
Inaya was staring at him with a gentle smile, tugging at the corner of her lips.
This instantly caused a gentle pain to ignite in Kent’s chest.

If this were before he recovered his memories, the first thing he would have done was sneer and throw some jabs at her. However, after recovering all his memories, his feelings for her changed completely.
The same annoying and very evil Inaya he knew was not the same lady staring at him. She now stood as the wife he never got to have. The mother of his children, he never got to meet.
Without knowing when or how he moved, he found himself wrapping his arms around her, tears rolling down his face.

"I-I...am...I" he tried to speak, but his emotions had completely taken over his voice. While it had been billions of years for Inaya, to him, it felt like yesterday, so his emotions were still so fresh.
Inaya and the rest of his wives were left stunned.

What they expected their first meeting to be like was not what was happening at the moment. In fact, they never saw this coming, considering that from what Ainna and Inaya recounted, it felt like Jest had stopped loving her and betrayed her by taking her mortal enemy instead.

The Kent they were looking at right now did not look like someone who had stopped loving her. If anything, he looked like someone who had missed his loved one so much that seeing them again was everything he cared about.
Inaya held her arms open, her chest rising and falling, unable to process what was happening. Thankfully, the goddess of love was there with them.
Unity walked forward and took her open arms, wrapping them around Kent.
"It is alright," she mouthed the words before walking away.
Inaya remained still for a few minutes before she tightened her hold on him. A few seconds later, tears started streaming down her face.
The emotional ones in the harem also started wiping their eyes.
Generally, the situation was indeed emotional. Nobody knew why that was. Maybe it was because of Unity. She, after all, is the goddess of love.
Her presence may have affected them, causing them to feel the emotion in the air a bit too strongly.

But thanks to that unknown force, the feeling in the air was both pleasant and needed. Even Ainna, who was against Jest’s return from the start, now felt somehow happy watching her friend hug the love of her life.

She met Inaya during the Divine Era. She was just starting up as a diviner when she met one of Inaya’s emotion clones. Just like how Jest met the clone of hers that sparked their years of rivalry, Ainna was the same.

However, unlike how Jest met the arrogant clone, she met the loving one. They became friends, and later, when Inaya merged back into all ten sword emotions, she looked for her, and after a few ups and downs, they became friends.
It turns out they were both from the same planet. So years later, when Inaya returned to start a family, Ainna was with her.

That was why, when she became heartbroken, Ainna was the one who helped her put herself back together. It can be said that during the worst part of Inaya’s life, she was the one standing beside her, giving her a reason to keep living.
That was why she was beyond pissed when she learned Jest was back.
Now, however, she was happy for her. Maybe later she would throw a tantrum again, but for now, she just wanted her friend to have the moment.
They all did. Kent and Inaya deserved this reunion, even if it was bittersweet.
Inaya tried several times to feel angry, sad, and maybe resentful. However, each time, she would rather tighten her hold on Kent instead.
A few minutes into it, she decided to let the moment carry her. There was no need to resist this pleasant atmosphere. Whatever there was to say, it could be said after the hug.
Of course, that was the plan. However, as they say, when there is calm for a moment, chaos is expected to follow.
Ironically, Kent himself was once called Chaos.
Only that this time, he was not the one who caused it.
The hugging was nearing its end, which, from the atmosphere, felt both nice and pleasant. However, that changed when a painful scream tore from Dia’s mouth.
She dropped to her knees and clutched her head. They rushed to her, even interrupting the emotional hug between Kent and Inaya.
While they had hugged for a couple of minutes, that scream brought everything to an abrupt end.
Dia stayed on the ground, screaming and beating her legs for ten good minutes.
When she finally recovered, tears slowly streamed down her face. She lifted her head and tried to look at Kent, but she could not keep her eyes on him for long.
It was as if she were too embarrassed to look him in the eye. In truth, she was indeed very embarrassed, considering what he now knew.
Kent knew what had happened, so with Inaya still in his arms, he walked toward her.
"Stop. Don’t come closer..." Dia distanced herself from him, her expression breaking...
"It is alright, Dia. None of this is your fault. It was merely a big, fat misunderstanding that should not have happened in the first place."

Kent could tell she had recovered her memories from her life during the Divine Era. Those memories contained all the terrible things she did, right up to the point when she met Jest on his way to Planet Genesis.
Jest was supposed to return home to Inaya. However, because of her, he was forced to make an impossible choice, one that shattered Jest’s heart for the duration of his life during the Divine Era.
It was also she who caused Inaya to develop a heart demon that had kept her restricted at the god stage, preventing her from moving on.
Compared to the several other terrible things she had done, now that she had those memories back, she felt like the worst person in the entire universe.

Kent moved closer and took Dia’s trembling hand. "It is all in the past now, Dia. I know you blame yourself for everything. However, the truth of the matter is, you also had no choice. It was who you were meant to be, and you merely played by the rules that bound you.
This time, however, we get to play by our own rules. So do not dwell on the past; let us focus on the future instead."
Dia would have loved to nod and put everything behind her. However, with the memories she had now, she would need a couple of weeks and Dori’s help to handle that.

chapters.title: Chapter 1519: Cursed
paragraphs: It is terrible how some people’s fates turned out.
Artemis was supposed to be the goddess of the hunt. However, she died before she could breathe even a small wisp of that glory.
Hera was supposed to grow into a beautiful woman and marry a very powerful king, but instead, her fate changed, leading her to become the curse of someone destined to fight for the universe.
They were all meant to be great, but somehow, they ended up being their own downfall.
Because of Chaos, Artemis died following a foolish dream. Then Hera, who was destined for greatness too, grew bitter, which led her to become Chaos’s heart demon.
While during the Primordial Era she did not haunt Chaos that much, she really wreaked havoc on him during the Divine Era, making her one of the few who actually managed to defeat Jest then.

So, while their fate was to be great people, they also brought about their own downfall. Now, as Kent, Dia, and Inaya stood together, one could tell they all played a hand they were never meant to be dealt.
"This is a bit strange..." Just when the moment started to become a bit strange, Ainna’s voice entered everyone’s ears, causing them to turn toward her.
When her gaze met Kent’s, she smirked.

"Hi, my name is Ainna, Inaya’s best friend, and the one who took care of her when you abandoned her. Also, sorry for trying to kill you back on Planet Brymrr. I never planned for you to actually nearly die.
That said, now that you are back and alive, you and I will have a good talk about my compensation."

"Nice meeting you, Ainna, and do not worry, I will compensate you better than before. But first, why don’t you tell us what is strange?"
Ainna did not say anything for a moment, perhaps pondering Kent’s initial words. ’What did he mean by compensating me better this time?’
She kept her thoughts running for a few seconds before a sigh escaped her mouth. She turned her focus to Dia. "She does not have a fate or destiny. The only thing she has is a cursed soul."
She paused for a moment and then reframed her sentence. "What I meant to say is, both her destiny and fate have been stolen and replaced with a devious curse."
"WHAT?" the ladies exclaimed, a shocked look appearing on their faces.
"Care to throw more light on what you just said?" Vexthra asked, and Ainna, who did not want to admit it but really felt intimidated by the goddess of hatred and resentment, nodded like a child.
Perhaps, if it were Kent who asked, she would have shrugged him off. But she could not do the same to Vexthra...

"While I hate to brag, I would like to point out that before I became an alchemist, I was actually an accomplished seer. I specialized in divination and fate reading. My third eye can see both the past and a bit of the future.
While I would not want to bore you with the details, one rule of divination is to know which thread of fate to pull and which window of destiny to pierce through.
It was how I saw you coming back to my best friend, and how I knew you would not die when I pitted you against that demigod."
She paused and smiled.
But then she recalled how close Kent came to near death. "Safe to say your fate is hard to reach.
However, that does not change the fact that I can see your complex, incomplete fate lines, same with these fine ladies’.
Hers, however, is blank in both the threads of fate and the windows of destiny. The only thing there is a large red crack filled with murderous intent. That only happens when one’s fate is stolen.
In simple terms, she is merely a puppet on a string."
"Who is controlling her?"
"That—" Ainna formed a hand seal and was about to place her finger on her forehead when a tiny hand appeared from thin air and grabbed it.
"Don’t." Akira appeared from thin air, holding back Ainna’s hand. "Had you done that, not even the ashes of your bones would have remained."
Ainna visibly shook, sweat forming on her brow. Instinctively, she moved closer to Akira, almost hugging her tiny body.
"What is going on, Akira?" Kent asked.

Among the three cosmic lolis in the tower, Akira is the cosmic weaver. She is more attuned to the soul. So if there is anything concerning fate, which is innately linked to the soul, she was bound to know.
What Kent never expected was her staying silent all this time, only to appear when Ainna revealed that Dia is fateless and destinyless, ultimately making her a cursed soul.
Akira scratched her head and smiled. "I cannot say, big brother. If I were to reveal anything, not only would all of you die, even I might die."
"Oh, it sounds serious."
"Very serious, big brother."
Kent nodded and asked again, "How serious are we talking?"
Akira thought for a moment and replied, "More serious than the worst of the Void Beasts and Forbidden Race combined."
Kent furrowed his brow for a few moments and nodded. "I understand. Sorry for the trouble, Akira. You can go back now."
She nodded and vanished into thin air, leaving a group of stunned beauties wondering what had just happened. Kent stood there, his mind calculating many things.
He may not have known who had stolen Dia’s fate and destiny, but he knew they were terrible. In fact, he could say they were the worst enemy he would ever face.
While he may not be aware of them yet, now that he knew they were somehow involved in the troubles that had plagued him, he would find them and make them pay.

"As Akira said, we cannot talk about it, so we should not talk about it. What you all should know, however, is that Dia is one of us, so no matter what, we will find a way to save her, regardless of how hard things get."
His wives nodded, Unity pulling her sister into a big hug.
Kent turned to Ainna and smiled. "I guess we can call it even. You tried to kill me, and now I almost did the same."
"They are not the same things. I never actually wanted you dead. I merely wanted a few bones broken and several teeth knocked out."
Kent grinned. "We can never truly get what we want, can we?"
"I guess we can’t. But you still owe me." After saying that, she turned around and walked to a nearby tree and sat under it. Kent could tell she was rattled by how close she had come to death.
Kent was not the only one who saw that. Inaya also did. However, for now, since she and Kent had a lot to catch up on, she decided to handle that first.
Thankfully, Kent had more than enough wives to attend to her.
Miryssa walked to her side and hugged her.
Kent nodded and added it to his bucket list to reward her later. Afterward, he turned to Inaya, and before long, they vanished into the Harem Tower.
Billions of years had passed, so there was much to say and much catching up to do.
