He is smart, but he seems to still be lacking.
Perhaps his lack had to do with still not having his memories of Kevin Sage back.
"Tower, buy all books and manuscripts on all kinds of ancient cryptographic algorithms out there.
I want everything from the dawn of time to this very moment." A pale smile appeared on his face.
"I guess it is time to hit the books again."
[I will do as the master says.
But I first have to let Gaia build a sizable library to store everything.]
Kent laughed.
Perhaps if he were to recover his memories of Kevin Sage, solving the pattern would be simple.
However, since he had yet to have that knowledge, acquiring it on his own for now seemed like a good thing.
"I might end up not needing it in the end, but for now, having a library would add to the beauty of the place."
He let the Tower save the extracted triangular pattern.
For now, he would end things there and continue later.
The last thing he wanted was to become absorbed in this and neglect his preparation for the mission coming up in a few months.
After stowing everything away, his focus turned to the last item he had bought at the auction house.
The moment the broken sword appeared, Gaap emerged from his soul sea as well.

Aside from him sensing the resentful qi coming from the sword when he saw it, Gaap was also attracted to it, and so he went ahead and lied through his teeth, claiming he planned on buying it as an antique when, in fact, he knew the broken sword was something extremely powerful.
"I don’t suppose you have any idea what this sword was before it broke?" Kent asked, but Gaap shook his head.
He moved closer to get a better look at it.

"I can clearly sense a very potent resentment coming from within; however, I can’t figure out how to access it." Gaap narrowed his eyes at the broken sword, his gaze drifting along the wooden hilt, paying close attention to the markings on it.
"Same here."
At the auction, they claimed there is a supreme-grade technique for cultivating sword aura hidden inside this sword.
However, Kent knew they were lying.
But despite calling their bluff, he also could not make sense of what was rooted deep inside the sword.
Maybe if he were the only one who sensed it, he would have doubted himself.
However, he, the Tower, and Gaap all sensed it, and so he knew the sword was a treasure.
But even after four hours of examining and trying all kinds of harmless experiments, nothing happened.
In the end, it came down to one final method.
"I suppose feeding it my blood would be the last thing to try.
Already, I couldn’t send my consciousness inside, and neither could you, so let me try that."
Gaap looked at Kent for a few seconds before nodding.
"Be careful, though.
While we have no idea what this sword is, the fact that it could scare someone like me shows it is a terrifying weapon."
Kent nodded, and then, after a sigh, he cut his palm and let his blood drip onto the hilt of the broken sword.

chapters.title: Chapter 1541: A Cursed Weapon
paragraphs: [Ancient Lore]
Legend has it that during the Flame Era, when the first batch of Flame Beasts invaded the Infinity universe, the warriors from every walk of life came together and fought a great battle.
In the end, they won.
Well, they won the first battle.
However, they soon realized something chilling.

When the second batch arrived, legendary warriors who stood in the vanguard realized their weapons had become useless against some of the Flame Beasts. No matter how deadly the attack was, as long as it came from some weapons, it dealt no damage whatsoever to the enemy.
It quickly became obvious why.
It turned out that when the second batch came, a special kind of flame beasts that specialized in soul attacks found a way to attack soul weapons, rendering them useless against their people.
Back then, soul weapons were the norm since they grew with the wielder. Every Blacksmith aspired to create all kinds of soul weapons and artifacts.
So the moment a soul weapon loses its soul, it becomes useless. This led to the slaughter of millions of warriors, bringing great loss to the universe.
After they finally managed to repel the second batch of the invading forces, the leaders of the universe started looking for solutions.
It was said that a Celestial Weapon without a soul mark cannot be compared to a God Weapon with a soul mark.
So, while there were powerful weapons like the Ten Divine Zodiac Spears and the like, weapons that could deal significant damage to this soul-type Flame Beast were needed.
If they can kill the soul flame beasts, then all other weapons will become useful again.
So blacksmiths and forgemasters were summoned from all over the universe to a summit that lasted 100 days.

During that time, powerful blacksmiths and forgemasters brought all kinds of solutions to the problem, but in the end, all were proven inadequate—that was until the Nine Underworld Flame Blacksmith arrived.
He came late, and as usual, he had a crazy idea that actually worked. He was known as the Mad Forger because every idea he brought sounded so crazy.

The legend says that this time, his proposal was very simple. Since the most powerful and corrupted part of the soul is resentment, he proposed crafting weapons with resentful souls as the weapon spirit.
His proposal was shut down, and he was mocked and called many names by his peers. However, by the middle of the third invasion, they were begging him to craft those weapons.
So he did.
He crafted 100 weapons, and he named them the 100 Cursed Weapons. Each weapon contained the soul of an unwilling, vile, and evil being.

Kent felt it deep within him that using his blood to try to see what the weapon was sounded like a bad idea. However, he wanted to find out anyway. In a way, he was too crazy to the point that he ignored all red flags.
He wants to find out more.
If not for himself, then he wanted his sword (Gaap) to be able to make use of the resentful qi in the sword. So he shut down all warnings and chose to use his blood.
He regretted that decision the moment his blood landed on the hilt of the sword.𝑓𝘳𝘦𝑒𝑤𝑒𝘣𝘯ℴ𝘷𝘦𝓁.𝑐𝑜𝑚
Just when it did, a very terrifying aura, one that would put even a Celestial to their knees, gushed out and grabbed Kent by the throat.
At once, he turned pale, and his body started to age. Blood drained from his body, his hair even turning pure white.
"Kekekekekekekeke... finally, I am free."
A bone-chilling laughter came from the sword, filling the entire Sword Tower with a great terror.
Gaap, who stood beside Kent just a moment ago, was reduced to a broken doll, his entire body crushed, transforming into his sword form.
Even in that form, the jagged blade had cracks all over it and was slowly expanding. Kent was also aging, his body turning paler by the second.
The air grew thick with resentment.
The sky even started to turn dark, lightning churning deep in the clouds. With each passing second, the air grew deadlier until, eventually, everything reeked of resentment.

"Finally, I will be able to roam this universe and exact my revenge on the punk." A misty smoke came from the sword and formed into a wraith-like man whose hair draped down his back, entangled with the same carved woods and series of ropes.
His expression was cold, and most importantly, his triangular-shaped eyes made him look both ugly and terrifying.
He looked at Kent for a moment, his ugly smile widening into a grin. "I don’t know who you are, boy, but thanks to your blood, I will get to live a full life this time.

Your body will be my new vessel, and your face will be my face that I will use to instill fear in the entire universe once again, like in the past, when my name alone was all it took to strike terror into the hearts of even Celestial beings.
Before that bastard captured me and turned me into a weapon spirit, I was a terror of existence. Now, thanks to you, I will be that again."
He laughed, "In your face Nine Underword Flame Bastard. I will find you and smash your face in you crazy bastard."
Kent had become even more frail and thin. However, his gaze remained calm, almost as if he wasn’t afraid of the terrifying, resentful soul holding him by the neck.

Sitting somewhere in Gaiaville, Baldy sighed and set down the cup containing the fruit juice that Elaine’s mother had given him. Then, with a single step, he vanished and appeared inside the Sword Tower.
The moment he appeared, the resentful soul noticed him and turned to look at him.
When its gaze landed on Baldy, it took several steps back, fear appearing on its ugly face.
"W-What are you?" It tried to push away the fear by asking a question. However, Baldy didn’t entertain him. He raised his right index finger and pressed down.
"Be suppressed."

The resentful soul crashed down, letting go of Kent. Once he was free, color started returning to his face, his hair turning back to its beautiful purple form. However, he gasped a few times for breath, his frail look recovering at an astonishing speed.
Baldy walked forward and stopped just before the broken sword.
With a gesture, the two broken pieces moved and connected. Then he pointed his other finger, and lightning formed, soldering the two broken pieces together again.
In no time, the sword was mended, becoming whole again.

Then, with another gesture, the suppressed, resentful soul moved and entered the sword, its screams filling the Sword Tower. In what appeared to be less than a minute, Baldy resolved the near-death situation that Kent and Gaap had found themselves in.

Kent remained on his knees, gasping for breath. Baldy ignored him and moved toward Gaap. Then, just like he did with the broken sword, he pointed his finger, and lightning formed at its tip and then shot at the sword.
Soon, the cracks that had formed on it healed, and Gaap transformed back into his demon form.
"Thank you, Senior," he thanked Baldy, who nodded at him before turning toward Kent. He knelt down and looked at his face for a few seconds before he smiled.

"You lied to me, big brother. You said I should wait for you, that you would come for me, but you never did." A pained look appeared on his face. "I was alone for billions of years. I felt so lonely and bored."

Kent, who had regained some of his strength, lifted his head and looked at the bald kid staring at him. His hand moved and brushed his bald head for a moment. "Sorry, Baldy. I did everything I could to get back to your side, but the bad guys turned out to be super powerful.
"But I am back now, so that should count for something."
Baldy looked at him for a few more seconds before he smiled. "I guess that is okay. But you will buy me alot of candy as compensation if you want me to help your sword become powerful."
"Oh," Kent furrowed his brow.

chapters.title: Chapter 1542: Gaap’s Unlimited Diet
paragraphs: Kent gave Baldy a curious look before his expression brightened.
Reaching into the system store, he purchased a large bowl of candy and handed it over to Baldy. Baldy grabbed it and started to eat right away.
Kent was pleased that Baldy only requested candy for such a difficult task, so he provided more than the boy could finish.
Even Gaap was left stunned.
He once told Kent his true strength was that of a peak Demigod. As a soul weapon, being a demigod is greater than even a soulless Celestial’s weapons.
His power is great, especially if wielded by someone like Kent.
His current strength is at Tier 19 sword. However, he can temporarily unleash a power beyond the Heavenly Ascension stage.
Of course, while he is useful at the moment, it was far from ideal. If he can become stronger, then perhaps he can help Kent more actively.
Nonetheless, he is a demigod.
However, despite having such great power, he fell short before the overwhelming might of the Resentful soul. But hearing he would be helped in absorbing the resentment filled his heart with joy.
"Well, how do I make Gaap more powerful?"
Baldy bit into a candy found only on Earth and savored its taste. Then he looked up and smiled at Kent. "Very delicious, master."
He licked his lips and was about to take another, but Kent grabbed his tiny ear, "Buddy, I believe you have something to say, don’t you?"
Baldy pouted and was about to protest when Kent made a move that instantly subdued him.
"There is more where these candies came from, you know."
Knowing that the ones he had now would finish one day, Baldy knew he had to think long-term, so all kinds of mischief he had in mind were washed away and replaced with the need to impress.
So he did, and the outcome put a smile on both Kent’s and Gaap’s faces.
"This weapon is already damaged and cannot be repaired, at least not by us. However, that is not of importance to us right now. The essential component here is the Resentful soul inside.

It had remained imprisoned inside for billions of years, only being freed when your blood touched the hilt. I have no idea why your blood was able to free it from prison, but it did, which, had I not been here, would have been your end.

Thankfully, I managed to put it back. Next, if you want, I can help this senior tap into the resentment and absorb it bit by bit while the resentful soul remains in the new prison I have built for it."
"Won’t absorbing it harm Gaap?"

"Not if the resentful soul inside the sword is not tied to any soul. I have to admit that if I weren’t a special case, subduing it would have been impossible. I don’t know who wielded this sword, but the resentment it has accumulated is already enough to shatter even the will of a Sword Celestial.
You are very lucky you didn’t die the moment it was freed. However, with the power of Eternal Essence suppressing it, Uncle Gaap will have nothing to worry about."
"Then there is no need to delay. Hook him up right away."

Kent, of course, was worried there for a moment. If such resentment was hooked to his own weapon, what then would happen to him? Gaap is a living sword, an existence that transcends even the realm of a soul weapon.

So endangering him is the last thing he wanted. However, since Baldy said he wouldn’t be in any danger regardless of how monstrous the Resentful soul was, he knew Gaap would soon become even more powerful.
Baldy proceeded to create a formation linking Gaap and the Resentful soul.

When it was brought out again, its curses filled the place. Clearly, it had been waiting for its freedom for a very long time. However, just when it had finally managed to escape, a much bigger obstacle blocked its path.
"Damn it. Curse you, Nine Flames. I curse your bloodline and loved ones. You shall never know peace. Your souls shall be tormented for all eternity.

And as for you three bastards, I call down the wrath of the Doomed One. One day, you three shall face a death so painful that your reincarnated souls will remain scarred forever. I spit on your graves, I stomp on your—"
His curses came to an end, then a reverent look appeared on his face. He turned, looked at Gaap, and bowed. "I will serve this Lord however he wants me to,"
Kent blinked a few times and turned to Baldy. "Well, what the heck just happened? I was kind of enjoying the curses he was raining down on us."

"Too bad for you I guess, I wasn’t, so I shut him up. Also, since Uncle Gaap is a living sword, I awakened a bit of his will, and that got him to shut up. It had been a sword spirit for billions of years, so resentment or not, it knew when to recognize greatness. Deep down, it had that sword will rooted in its nature. Right now, that resentful will recognized a superior one, and that forced it to shut up."
Baldy bit into a chocolate candy. "Ahh, the peace and quiet."
Kent ignored him and turned to Gaap, who was already seated, absorbing bits of the resentful spirit. The poor bastard sat across from him, his excited gaze locked on Gaap.
Kent didn’t know how to feel about this.

"Relax, Big Brother. Even if he wanted to hurt him, under my suppression and Uncle Gaap’s superior will, he couldn’t do anything. So don’t worry about him. Let Uncle Gaap handle it. I am sure he will turn this resentment into a great fortune."
Kent nodded, but he still told the tower to keep an eye on him at all times. The last thing he wanted was his sword to be put in danger because of their greed.

Afterward, he exhaled and turned to Baldy. "I have to ask, have you heard anything from your siblings? A couple of years ago, I read in a certain scroll that Bob was captured and imprisoned by the Angels. Later, when the City of Angels disappeared, he also disappeared.
What the hell happened when I was gone?"

Baldy looked at Kent for a few seconds and smiled. "Big Brother Bob is indeed gone, along with the City of Angels. But he is still alive, though far from reach. He did say we should come find him when you return, though."
"I see. Then how about the others?"

"Well, Big Brother Ted hasn’t contacted me even once since he left, but I learned from Big Sister Vic that he had ventured to the unknown levels of Hell and been exploring one Hell Abyss after another. I don’t know if he is still there, but even if he is, I don’t care. He is a bastard like you."
"Wow, Baldy, no need to be harsh about it. I died, you know, so it wasn’t like I abandoned you of my own accord."
"But you knew you would die, so why didn’t you give me a heads up? I waited for millions of years, still believing you would come back.

When you didn’t, I came out looking for you for another million years until Big Brother Mak found me and told me you died. I was so heartbroken to the point I wanted to never see you again. Alas, here we are."
Kent grinned but said nothing. It turned out it wasn’t just Inaya he had hurt...

I died, you know, so it wasn’t like I abandoned you of my own accord."
"But you knew you would die, so why didn’t you give me a heads up?
I waited for millions of years, still believing you would come back.
When you didn’t, I came out looking for you for another million years until Big Brother Mak found me and told me you died.
I was so heartbroken to the point I wanted to never see you again.
Alas, here we are."
Kent grinned but said nothing.
It turned out it wasn’t just Inaya he had hurt...

chapters.title: Chapter 1543: Shadow Emperor
paragraphs: Among the seven Eternal Sword Intents he had refined, Baldy was the cutest simply because his mind was that of a child, despite being extremely brilliant.
Kent can even say he is the most intelligent among the seven Eternal Sword intents.

The others came out as fully grown beings, but he remained a 13-year-old child. Due to his cuteness and a bit of childish behavior, Jest planned to travel the universe and had so much fun along the way.
Unfortunately for him, they never did because he died in the climax of the Divine War. So he understood perfectly why he was heartbroken.
However, while he would love to say he had no idea he would be dying in that last battle, he knew deep down he would, but chose not to tell him.
Jest had a bad premonition before facing the Abyss king. Maybe if he had told Baldy this, he wouldn’t have been too heartbroken.
His death wasn’t because he wanted to escape him; it was a necessary decision that saved the universe.

He, too, would have loved to take his little bro on a trip across the universe after everything was over. It would have even helped him gain a bit of his happiness after all the shenanigans with Inaya and his heart demon.
Safe to say that never happened.
"I am sorry, Baldy. I should have made you aware that the last battle would be a life-or-death one. For that, I apologize and promise to take you on a tour around the universe this time around."
Kent smiled and brushed his hand against his bald head. "After all, we have to look for your siblings. They each owe me a sword technique."

Baldy nodded. "I will enjoy that very much. That said, Big Brother Ted is in Hell, and Big Sister Vic has ventured into some unknown ruin that came from the Primordial Era. As for Big Brother Mak, he is somewhere in the Succubus Empire."
Kent raised his brow. "Say what now?"

"Ha," Baldy laughed. "Big Brother Mak only likes to hang around ladies, so he has been there for millions of years. He occasionally contacts me to check up on me. Come to think of it, he was the only one who checked up on me.
Though his last check-in was 2 million years ago, so there is no telling if he is there again."
"I see. What about Pat and Han?"
"Big Sister Pat would probably be drifting somewhere in the Void. Her technique had to do with the void, so she has been moving from one void realm to the next.
As for Big Brother Han, none of us heard from him except that during the Flame Era, he appeared briefly and cut down a Pseudo-Primordial. Afterward, he was gone.

Big Sister Vic speculated that he is somewhere in this universe, walking among mortals. Also, we all think he has long succeeded in comprehending everything about his technique and might have long surpassed it."
"So in short, he is the strongest of you."
"Yes. But I wouldn’t say that in front of Big Sister Vic. She is the prideful type."
"Noted." Kent smiled, a bit happy and a bit concerned about the safety of his Eternal Sword Intents. He knew that, while they may look and feel human, they are beings who stand above this universe.
They are limited in what they can do, so if they make the wrong move, there is a good chance they will find themselves in danger, the kind that will restrict them forever.
They may be superior beings, but they still have to play by the rules.

In the end, he was happy Baldy had now returned to his side. The rest would take care of itself. After spending more time catching up with Baldy, he proceeded to handle the other issues on his roster.
The first was the two Demigod soul spirits inside his Soul Universe. He tried to create two more soul warriors; however, it didn’t work.
It turned out his soul was still too weak to handle the creation of any soul warrior above the rank of a True Immortal.
Unfortunately for him, all the potential soul warrior candidates were above the rank of True Immortals. So he was forced to abandon that plan and focus instead on increasing his Assassin Class.
He expected to become a Shadow Emperor and awaken his Shadow Realm upon becoming a sword emperor. However, that didn’t happen; instead, he was given a requirement.
Granted, the requirement was just ridiculous. It wasn’t something he had to even worry about.
[Requirement to become a Shadow Emperor]
↠ Steal the Face of an Immortal
He was only required to use the Faceless Art to steal the face of an immortal.

While in a way this requirement would have been a bit harrowing, considering that finding an immortal and killing one was above the ranking of a mortal, Kent happened to have over a dozen of them, some inside the tower prison, while others were in the void prison.
He quickly brought one over and used the technique on him, adding yet another face to his arsenal.
The moment that was done, he advanced to the Shadow Emperor stage, and his Faceless Shadow Realm awakened.
Unlike his Genesis Sword Realm, this one was a bit bone-chilling. The moment it awakened, the entire Sword Tower became shrouded in darkness.
Bone-chilling enough, the moment the darkness filled the domain, Kent himself felt his back break into a cold sweat.

Hidden in the darkness, he could feel the gaze of thousands, perhaps millions of beings, each a monster in their own right, locked on him. It felt as if he had opened the first layer to a rather dangerous domain.
"There is something different about my Faceless Realm."
Just like with his Sword Realm, the Faceless Realm was something Faceless created. However, it wasn’t this harrowing in the past. Now, he had no idea what had become of his Shadow Realm.
Though he was sure of one thing: although there were dangers lurking within his shadow, they weren’t something he should be worried about.
They weren’t life-threatening, at least not to him.

He planned to explore it more, but he was forced to abandon that idea when the requirement to become a Shadow Divine appeared. Of course, he never expected it to have anything to do with his Shadow Realm.
But it did.
[Requirement to become a Shadow Divine]
↠ Kill 100,000 Root Immortals to awaken 1,000 Shadow Fiends.
↠ Kill 80,000 Core Immortals to awaken 100 Shadow Fiends.
↠ Kill 50,000 Spirit Immortals to awaken 100 Shadow Fiends.
↠ Kill 10,000 True Immortals to awaken 100 Shadow Fiends.
↠ Kill 1,000 Immortal Kings to awaken 100 Shadow Fiends.
The requirement was a bit stacked, but that wasn’t what took Kent aback. "Shadow Fiends, aren’t they those creatures that live in the Shadow Realm?"

His memories of Faceless ended when he was planning to head into the Shadow Realm. Back then, he researched that place thoroughly, so he knew the creatures there were called Shadow Fiends.𝙛𝒓𝓮𝒆𝔀𝒆𝙗𝓷𝒐𝙫𝒆𝙡.𝒄𝓸𝓶
They were cursed beings said to have been imprisoned by the Shadow Dao for all eternity.
Hearing that he could now awaken them by killing thousands of immortals sounded all too good to be true. But then again, he had no idea why he would be deceived.
This meant he would indeed awaken them soon.
"But how would they appear, and just where in the heavens am I going to get that many immortals and kill?" he sighed and let the moment wash over him for now.
"I suppose another trump card unlocked."

chapters.title: Chapter 1544: Plans to Form The First Chaos Heart
paragraphs: Two years soon passed inside the tower.

During that time, Kent’s wives returned from Planet Rainy after meeting the High Priestess and a few of her elders. They had a good discussion with them, which, after a full day, seemed to have yielded positive results.
With Princess Luciana joining the conversation, it ended well. After their return, they started planning the next steps.

Luckily for them, Gaia and her team were done with the portal a few days after they returned to the tower. They wanted to inform Kent of the new developments, but, learning from the tower he was training in, they refrained from disturbing him.
Instead, Vexthra and her sisters commissioned the largest city yet.
In Kent’s absence, Gaia spent 2 billion tower points to build a grand city capable of housing 16 million plus Rabbitkin.
They called it the City of Rain, taking after their dying planet, Planet Rainy. They had yet to move in since they planned to meet Kent first.
But the city is done, and afterward, they commissioned a new one. Since Kent had informed them he planned to move Uncle Drake’s people into the tower, they knew they would need a new city.

Even if they aren’t that many, which means they can occupy the empty rooms in Gaiaville, they knew just how arrogant dragons can be, so having their own city was for their own good and the poor humans they refer to as inferior beings.
If one day they learn to live with other races and want to move there, nobody will stop them.
They named it Pyraxia, after Uncle Drake’s homeworld back during the Primordial Era.

In a span of two years, two big cities had been built, bringing the total number of cities to six: Gaiaville for the humans, Blood City for the Bloodvein tribe, Nature City for the Elves (all kinds of elves), Skyjade City for the Sky Foxes and some other foxes, City of Rain for the Rabbitkin, and finally Pyraxia for the dragons.
While all that was happening, Kent chose to hone his dagger skills and a few assassination techniques he had used as the Faceless Assassin.
Since he had awakened his shadow realm, he knew he had to wield that power alongside his sword skills.
While he wasn’t a shadow Celestial back in the day, he had reached the shadow god stage, so he had more than enough knowledge to support his training.
Before long, he was absorbed in his training, which lasted a year and a half.

The allure of finally awakening his shadow realm, and the fact that, back in the day, to kill just one person, he could train and plan for years, making sure no mistakes were made, fueled his determination this time around to train even more.
By the time he was done, his assassination skills had been honed to a new kind of sharpness.
He freshened up and left for the legion tower. He was shocked to find no one there, so he proceeded to the Mountain Garden.
"Big Brother," The moment he appeared there, Gaia and her friends jumped onto his arm and all over him, each finding a part of his body to hold.

With Aysel and Li Hua now in seclusion, only Gaia, Akira, Dori, Aala (from the sky fox race), Purity, Yuna, and Risana (Vexthra’s sister) were in the garden when he got there. By the time he managed to get them all off, his white shirt was dyed in chocolate.
"How are you all doing?" Kent asked, holding Aala and Risana’s hands.

They all seemed okay, though he could tell they had been waiting for him. However, since they couldn’t play now, he promised to play with them when everything was over. Thankfully, they were reasonably tiny ladies, so after a few kisses on their cheeks, he was allowed to go to his wives.
At this point, they all seemed to have arrived at the same conclusion: Kent is a magnet for lolis. It started with Gaia, and now he had nine of them, with Nana almost done forming her body.
"You really should find a time and spend an entire year with them. They miss you very much," Vexthra said before locking lips with him.
After sharing a kiss, he turned, looked at Gaia and her friends, and smiled. "I really should do that. Though I wonder what they will enjoy doing, considering they enjoy everything."

"Then do everything with them. You are from a mortal world, so maybe let the tower create a playground with all that stuff there. You can finally have a playground for the other kids in the tower cities."
"Not a bad idea." He kissed Miryssa, too, then wrapped his hand around her waist.
"So where are the others?" Aside from Gaia and her friends, only Vexthra and Miryssa were in the garden, and from the look of things, they seemed to be waiting for him.
"They are with the legion on Planet Rainy. Some of them also followed Uncle Drake back home."

"Oh, I see. I suppose that will save me some time." Since he planned to bring the dragons into the tower, he would first have to travel there. But with some of his legions already there, he could just teleport and bring them inside.
"Yes. But first, we must head to Planet Rainy. I believe it is time for you to form your first Chaos Heart and undergo the Dragon Tribulation. The High Priestess also wants to meet you."
Kent furrowed his brow, unsure if what he had heard was indeed real. "Uhm, did I just..."

"Yes. We have prepared everything for you. We have four Chaos Heart Stones, of which you will only need one. We also have the Dragon Ascension Fruit, and most importantly, we have secured a large enough dragon vein for you. You will have more than enough Dragon Spirit Essence to use."
"Errrhh..." This time, his eyes widened. Miryssa and Vexthra laughed.

"You already said that if you could get your hands on Dragon Spirit Essence, then aside from forming a Chaos Heart, you could also temper your body. As it turns out, Planet Rainy is at death’s door, so we bought it for 2 billion tower points and planned to extract the Dragon Spirit Essence from the dragon veins before it perishes.
Because it is already dying, there will be no backlashes when we extract it. Also, we have their permission.
Based on the size of the planet, we will get over 100,000 drops of Dragon Spirit Essence. I believe that is more than enough to aid you in tempering your dragon body."
Kent could only stare at his two goddesses, his emotions rising. In the past, Chaos had to hunt down and kill to get his hands on the materials he used to form his Chaos Hearts and temper his body.
It was a dangerous and, more importantly, tiresome endeavor.
So, hearing that his wives had prepared everything for him, he felt like the most loved person in the universe right now.
"Don’t get emotional on us, love. Miryssa and I were the main brains behind the operation, so maybe give us special rewards once you are done."
Kent smiled and kissed them. "I will be sure to reward you all till you can’t lift yourselves off the bed."
They blushed, feeling his steady hands on their backsides. After sharing one more kiss, they decided to go to Planet Rainy, where he would first meet the High Priestess and then start the migration.
Afterward, he will begin the tempering process.
They appeared in a different garden somewhere in a large mansion where some of his wives were spending the afternoon having tea.
When they saw him arrive, they jumped into his arms, each one coming in for a hug and kiss.

chapters.title: Chapter 1545: Forming the First Chaos Heart (1)
paragraphs: Kent only spent a couple of minutes with his wives before leaving with Vexthra and Miryssa to meet the High Priestess.

"You should know that in order to secure the dragon vein, we had to use your name to convince. Even so, they seem to have some trust issues, so you must do well to convince them, especially the High Priestess."
Kent nodded. Convincing women is his field of expertise.
His wives had no worry on that front, so soon, they entered a large hall where the elders and the High Priestess had been waiting for them.
The moment Kent stepped into the hall, eyes turned to him.
He retracted his dragon horns so only his slightly longer ears could prove he was a dragon. And maybe his eyes, since they were a bit primal rather than mundane.
At the head of the hall, a blue-haired beauty sat on a throne, her gaze locked on him.
’A demigod, huh.’

Kent smiled inwardly, feeling that the High Priestess was trying to pry into his secrets. He knew she would never succeed, so he showed no expression to suggest otherwise. Instead, he maintained his stride, and before long, they were standing before everyone.
"Hi everyone, this is Kent Madson."
Kent smiled. "Nice meeting you all, amazing people, and sorry for making you wait."
None of them said anything. Rather, they turned to the High Priestess, who remained calm, her gaze still locked on him. A few minutes later, she sighed and gestured for them to sit.
Kent and his two wives walked and sat down on the chairs reserved for them.
"So you are Kent Madson," the High Priestess asked.
"That is me."
"I see. Considering the kind of fame you have, I expected someone very scary, not a harmless boy."
Kent smiled handsomely. "I get that a lot, High Priestess. When people learn I am Kent Madson, they assume I am some kind of monster who would make even the gods break into a cold sweat.

The truth of the matter is, I am harmless but also extremely dangerous when I have to be. That said, I am sure we are not here to talk about how harmless I am. We are here to talk about whether or not I have what it takes to protect you and your people."
Kent smiled and turned to Vexthra and Miryssa. "Let’s pretend these two beautiful ladies aren’t literal goddesses."
Their eyes widened. Clearly, Vexthra and Miryssa failed to tell them they are goddesses.

Kent didn’t allow them to interrupt him, though. "If you and your people move into the place I have in mind, first of all, you will have nothing like poverty chasing after you. I will provide everything from food to a place to sleep.
Of course, since you are people and people require a sense of purpose, while I will provide cultivation resources, you will also have a way to work and earn money for your own expenditure.
Second, you will have the chance to interact with others. There are humans, Foxkins, Elves, Bloodveins, and a few others. It is still a rising city, so you will see more later.

Third, let’s talk about security. Aside from my dear wives, there are several immortals, demigods, a god soon to be a supreme, and, well, an existence that can even scare away a celestial there to protect you and your people.

Lastly, while I can’t tell you why just yet, know that when it comes to me, there is no telling just what is impossible. So far, I have appeared on three Dao Tablets, and while I hate to brag, the entire Cult of Wisdom and Pill Council wants me to join their ranks. In fact, they have hired the best of the Midnight Shadows to protect me from the shadows.

So ask yourself, even if you all are in danger, which I doubt would ever happen, wouldn’t the reason that I would also be in danger be a more than enough reason for the Pill Council or Cult of Wisdom to send down their aid to protect me and, by extension, protect you all..."
There was no sound for ten minutes.
They all seemed to have a lot to think about. In the end, a sound decision was made. "We accept your explanation and will take you up on your offer."
Kent smiled. "A sound decision, High Priestess. I do believe my fine ladies here explained the dynamics of where you are going to you."
She nodded. "They did, and we accept."
Kent asked no further questions and merely turned to Vexthra. "I believe it is time to send them to their new home."
She smiled and connected with her sisters.
They all flew away, some teleporting to the other cities. The High Priestess had already announced that there was a chance they would be migrating to a new place, so they had all started preparing.
Meeting Kent was a formality, and to be frank, she was impressed by what she heard.

She had already planned to move her people to a different planet since every single day they faced all kinds of danger, be it from mutated beasts or unstable void tears that seemed to appear at random.
The offer to move into the tower was sound, and thanks to Vexthra and Miryssa, they agreed. Now, she merely tapped into some formations and announced to everyone that they would soon be moving out.
With space rings at their disposal, they quickly packed their stuff and were ready.
Vexthra gave a new command, and soon the portals were opened.

Before long, they started to move into the tower, some even jumping through only to land on a clean surface made from the finest jade. Before them was a large city spanning several thousand kilometers.

It was vast and beautiful, leaving every last one of them stunned for a moment when they laid eyes on it. It took some of them several moments to come to terms with the fact that this was the place they would be staying for the rest of their lives.

Meanwhile, back on Planet Rainy, Kent felt his soul universe expanding with every soul that entered the portal. In no time, he felt as if he were about to break through, that his soul would rise far beyond Tier 19.
That didn’t happen. However, he knew his soul had become much stronger.
He was even sure he would be able to surpass an Immortal Lord in terms of soul strength whenever he ascended to the next rank.
It took hours for everyone to enter.
At some point, he was even unsure whether the city could hold all of them. Thankfully, even after all 16,590,000 of them entered, 20% of the houses remained unoccupied.
When the portals were closed, Kent saw a different kind of message appear, putting a smile on his face.
[Master, I will be unavailable for two days to undergo an impromptu upgrade]

Kent was happy, so even when he lost access to the tower, he didn’t mind. Thankfully, he had no reason to go into the tower for now since he had to handle his Chaos Heart creation and dragon body tempering.
Of course, if he needed anything, Gaia was available to help.
For now, with Miryssa, Vexthra, Inaya, and Ainna protecting him, he had nothing to worry about. Vexthra led him to the dragon vein, and she even aided him in extracting all the Dragon Spirit Essence.
Once that was handled, they moved to a place they had already prepared, and after he entered, they sealed it and began guarding him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1546: Forming the First Chaos Heart (2)
paragraphs: [Lore]

The dynasty of the Beast Race is a little deeper than many would expect. During the Primordial Era, the Beast Race was considered the strongest simply on the basis of factors such as strength, speed, innate talents, and bloodline power.
These factors severely skewed the balance in their favor, and as a result, they ruled the universe with an iron fist.
The Chaos Dragon was the same.
He grew up thinking humans don’t measure up to dragons. In his view, even other beasts are inferior beings.
He believed dragons were superior in every aspect, so even when he was taught how to live like a human, he despised that idea.
Naturally, as a dragon, arrogance is innate to him.
However, if one were to sit down and analyze the evolutionary path of dragons, they might finally see why they are arrogant yet the strongest in the universe.

The first generation of dragons were body cultivators. They tempered their bodies to the point that their bloodline was heavily influenced by it. So when the second generation of dragons came, some were already inherently blessed with strength.
But a true dragon knew tempering their body alone wasn’t enough. They needed ways to take advantage of their stronger bodies. So they found a way, as they did with body tempering.
Bloodline tempering, or what we call cultivation today, was born.
By increasing one’s strength, their bloodline grew stronger until the second generation became the ultimate race.
Then the third generation came, and they saw that with how strong a dragon had become in both body and bloodline, why not make it so they had more than one source of energy to channel from?
Granted, a dragon core is the strongest and largest in the beast kingdom. They have more energy than most, at least during the first few generations of evolution.
However, a dragon is an ambitious being, so they wanted more. In that case, they chose to venture into dual-core cultivation, which later became the norm.
They called it Dragon Heart Evolution, and in history, the Chaos Dragon had the strongest Dragon Heart ever recorded.
History has it that the day the Chaos Dragon first formed his core, Generals, Kings, Queens, Emperors, Empresses, Monarchs, and even Sovereigns ran from their domains, fear gripping them.
He became undisputed in the Blood Region.
The Primordial Chaos Dragon was feared not because he was the strongest from the start or the most talented—he was feared because he was the most dangerous.
A Chaos Heart is like an additional tank of energy that runs indefinitely. Such was the power of the Primordial Chaos Dragon, the most powerful beast to ever live.
Today, Kent aspired to create history again, only that this time, he was a bit more powerful than before. This time, he had more resources at his disposal than before.
"The last time, I had just 25,000 drops of Dragon Spirit Essence and one Chaos Heart Stone. Today, I have over 600,000 drops, four Chaos Hearts, and even a Dragon Ascension Fruit."
Kent turned and looked at the two other treasures added to the roster.
"Blood Life Fruit and Stone Heart Fruit," he smiled, very happy and eternally grateful to his wives for going the extra mile for him.
"I only needed a few drops of Dragon Spirit Essence and a Chaos Heart Stone. However, since I now have these added treasures, then I will have to create something that will make them happy."
The look of determination appeared in his eyes as he examined the items he would be using.

The [Chaos Heart Stone] is a special stone condensed from the very purified essence of chaos. Just one Chaos Heart Stone is enough to wipe out an entire planetary system. The chaos energy stored inside it, if detonated at the right time, will wipe out over 60 planets from existence.

Kent would have to swallow it and use his body as a container to hold the chaos energy and then recompress it, only that this time, he would have to use it to create a core, or as it is called, a heart capable of absorbing chaos energy.
But since he needed to hold that much energy inside his body, he would first have to obtain a body strong enough to handle that much chaos energy.
That is where the [Dragon Spirit Essence] comes in.
He would have to temper his body and undergo the first dragon tribulation, where he would have to shed his scales and form new ones. This process is agonizing, and he is going to suffer severely.

However, before that, he would have the chance to strengthen his bloodline. He was currently at 26% awakening. If he were to absorb the [Dragon Ascension Fruit], then adding 5% more awakening to his belt wouldn’t be too bad.
Aside from that, he could also absorb the [Blood Life Fruit] since his cultivation path is the Slaughter Path.
As for the [Stone Heart Fruit], he would find out once everything was over.

"Okay, first, I need to temper my body. But to do that, I must increase my bloodline, and what is the best way to do that than taking in the [Dragon Ascension Fruit] and also absorbing the [Blood Life Fruit].
These two will get me started. Maybe I won’t suffer too much during the tribulation and scale shedding."
He could only hope for the best. He saw, from Chaos’s memories, how painful the process was.

"Come to think of it now, maybe Chaos’s wickedness toward others wasn’t intentional. Perhaps after undergoing several tribulations and enduring that much pain, his mind broke to the point that the pain of others doesn’t get to him."
Kent grinned. "But then again, what is a little bit of madness when the benefits are just too good to be true?" he laughed, causing the mood around him to turn a bit crazy.
His smile was also a bit evil, and his overall demeanor reeked of someone intent on defying the rules of common sense.
"I guess the Dragon Council was right, I am indeed a bit out of my mind," taking the [Dragon Ascension Fruit], he regarded it for a few seconds, then brought it to his nose and smelled it.

"Ah, these girls are spoiling me rotten," he grinned and thought of something. "Good thing I am about to become a bit chaotic. I will need a way to release some of that energy I will accumulate." He smiled and bit into the fruit.
He closed his eyes and savored the taste. The energy traveled through his body, opening pathways he never knew existed.
Slowly, he felt energized. But that was just the start of his transformation.
His bloodline began to stir, and with every bite, he felt the sensation travel deep into his body until he felt he was about to make a major breakthrough.

He devoured the last remaining fruit and formed a hand seal, regulating the energy to some parts of his body. He let the energy move through his brain, eyes, ears, mouth, throat, chest, and even down to his nails.
Kent knew he would have a chance to temper his body. However, crazy as he was, he chose to start with the Dragon Ascension Fruit because why not?
At the end of the day, he would have a chance to awaken some innate talents. So he just wanted his options to be open.
"Ah, I am indeed one crazy bastard."

chapters.title: Chapter 1547: Forming the First Chaos Heart (3)
paragraphs: Inaya, Vexthra, Miryssa, and Ainna were on the outside, guarding the location where Kent was undergoing his cultivation. They want to protect him from all kinds of danger.
Since this planet was once ravaged by a harrowing battle and later invaded by the Soul Temple, they knew they could not let down their guard, not even for a moment.
Soon, a day went by, but they remained focused.
While it was a bit unwarranted for them to be so focused, considering all four of them are gods, they knew the Soul Temple would surely come to investigate the sudden deaths of their agents.

So they continued to wait and hope, with every fiber of their being, that they would not come until after Kent was done. Learning that a Celestial had already tried to kill him once, they knew a second time was not impossible.

Thankfully, even after a day and a half, nobody showed up, so they remained on guard, but a bit more relaxed. They could sense Kent was done with a step... well, even the beasts in the forest sensed it, and some even tried to come after him.
However, as they drew closer, something a bit chilling happened.

All the beasts that managed to get within a 2 km radius of where he was in seclusion were killed by Vexthra. However, the moment they died, their bodies disintegrated and turned into blood mist that flowed and entered the cave, merging with Kent.
Whenever that happened, they would sense his aura rise.
So, with them already having nothing to do, they suppressed their cultivation to the demigod stage and started killing the beasts, feeding Kent more blood.
If it would take the blood of millions of beasts on Planet Rainy for Kent to come out of his seclusion as a monster, then that was what they would do.
Kent sensed their intentions, so he promised to make good use of their efforts. Thankfully, absorbing the [Dragon Ascension Fruit] had done more good than he expected.
Although the tower still had a few hours before it finished its upgrade, Kent was able to access the system interface, so when the messages started to flood in, he could only smile.
[You have absorbed a god-grade Dragon Ascension Fruit.]
[Congratulations, you have awakened 35% of your bloodline.]
[Congratulations, you have unlocked 10,000 Blood Runes. Total: 90,000]
[Congratulations, you can now unlock two more innate talents]
This message came when he absorbed the fruit. While he expected a 5% boost in bloodline awakening, he ended up getting 9% instead. It was already 26% when he ate the fruit, so he is now 35%.
Naturally, that was more than he expected, especially when he had suffered to reach the 26% awakening mark.
But things did not end there. As blood was absorbed into his body, he began to sense something even more profound happening.
Initially, he could not put his finger on it. However, his confusion was cleared when a second batch of messages started to appear.
[You are absorbing a large amount of blood essence. This phenomenon has triggered a sudden awakening.]
[Congratulations, you have unlocked a variant innate ability: Blood Tempering]
[Blood Tempering]
[Rank: Innate]
[Description: Using blood from any source, temper your blood, inheriting some innate aspects of the blood used in the tempering.]
Kent blinked a few times when these messages were displayed. There was no way he actually read that right. Tempering his blood with another’s blood—how does that even work?
Blood is intangible, so how then can he temper it?
His confusion, however, was soon cleared when he realized the thing being tempered was not his blood, but rather his blood seals.
He had no idea how any of it was possible, especially when Chaos had not gone through this process before. He had no memory of him ever tempering his blood runes.
From what he had recalled so far, after all blood runes had been awakened, he would then proceed to the next stage, which is Blood Tattoo Creation. Tempering his blood runes was all too new to him.
But it was happening to him, and for a moment, his mind scanned through Chaos’ memories to look for a clue.
After a while, he sighed. A thought came to mind, but he couldn’t place his finger on it.
"I have seen something similar before; I just can’t remember where," he continued, going through his memories for another two hours, but nothing came to mind.𝙛𝒓𝓮𝒆𝔀𝒆𝙗𝓷𝒐𝙫𝒆𝙡.𝒄𝓸𝓶
So he changed his approach and started looking at the skills and techniques related to his path—the Slaughter Path.
This time, it took only five minutes to find what he was looking for.
Hidden within the expanded description of the [Bone Tempering Art], he saw that the blood runes formed could have different colors—four, to be precise.

"When formed, they come in crimson color. Many beasts, and even humans, have this blood-essence innate color. However, after some evolution, they will become golden. Monarch-level beasts have this color.
The third color is crimson-gold, which happens when the third evolution is met. Only a few Beast manaed to reach this, and in the vast universe, they were called Overlord Beasts.
As for the last color, which is Dark-Gold, no beast ever recorded in history managed to attain this."

"Chaos only reached the first evolution, at least from the memories I have now. But if that was the case for him, then what would happen when I attain the second or even third evolution before forming my blood tattoos?"
Suddenly, Kent felt like he had nearly been conspired against.
"That bastard, he clearly said nothing about this." The image of the Slaughter King appeared in his mind, causing him to grit his teeth.

If not for the unfortunate accident that happened when Vexthra killed the beasts, and he ended up absorbing the blood mist, he would not have awakened the [Blood Tempering Art] innate ability, which meant he would not have even known of this evolution path.
"Damnit, that sly bastard." Kent made a mental note not to tell him his mind when they meet again.
"But then again, I wonder if the tempering will continue even after I form the blood tattoos."
A smile appeared on his face as he sensed the blood being absorbed by him suddenly start to increase.
"Since we are here now, then I might as well eat the [Blood Life Fruit] and see where we go from there."
He reached for the crimson-colored fruit and bit into it, savoring the metallic taste of blood souring his tongue. He did not mind and continued to bite and eat.
This time too, he regulated the blood energy flowing through his body through parts like his brain, eyes, nose, ears, teeth, ribs, and all kinds of body parts, down to his nails.
Soon, the first few messages appeared.
[You have absorbed a god-grade Blood Life Fruit.]
[Congratulations, you have unlocked 10,000 Blood Runes. Total: 100,000]
...a few seconds later, a new message appeared.
[Congratulations, you have unlocked 5,000 Blood Runes. Total: 105,000]
[Congratulations, you have unlocked all 105,000 blood runes]
...but things did not end there. In fact, it was merely the start of something that even if the Slaughter King were to witness it, his jaws would have to be supported by large metallic pillars.
[You have absorbed a large amount of Blood Qi.]
[Your Eternal Draconic Cultivation is trying to absorb some into your cultivation.]
[You have leveled up. Rank: Level 8 Heavenly Ascension]
[You have leveled up. Rank: Level 9 Heavenly Ascension]
[You have reached the peak]
[You still have excess Blood Qi in your body.]
[The Bone Tempering Art has been triggered, and it is trying to make use of the excess energy.]
...Kent remained calm, his expression focused on the message that would appear next. He had no idea what to do at this point, so he let his body make all the decisions.
Soon, however, the decision was made, and the results were something he never saw coming.
[You have formed 1,000 blood runes. Total: 106,000]
[You have formed 1,000 blood runes. Total: 107,000]
[You have formed 1,000 blood runes. Total: 108,000]
[You have met the requirement to evolve your blood to the second evolution stage]

sentences.text: Inaya, Vexthra, Miryssa, and Ainna were on the outside, guarding the location where Kent was undergoing his cultivation.
They want to protect him from all kinds of danger.
Since this planet was once ravaged by a harrowing battle and later invaded by the Soul Temple, they knew they could not let down their guard, not even for a moment.
Soon, a day went by, but they remained focused.
While it was a bit unwarranted for them to be so focused, considering all four of them are gods, they knew the Soul Temple would surely come to investigate the sudden deaths of their agents.
So they continued to wait and hope, with every fiber of their being, that they would not come until after Kent was done.
Learning that a Celestial had already tried to kill him once, they knew a second time was not impossible.
Thankfully, even after a day and a half, nobody showed up, so they remained on guard, but a bit more relaxed.
They could sense Kent was done with a step... well, even the beasts in the forest sensed it, and some even tried to come after him.
However, as they drew closer, something a bit chilling happened.
All the beasts that managed to get within a 2 km radius of where he was in seclusion were killed by Vexthra.
However, the moment they died, their bodies disintegrated and turned into blood mist that flowed and entered the cave, merging with Kent.
Whenever that happened, they would sense his aura rise.
So, with them already having nothing to do, they suppressed their cultivation to the demigod stage and started killing the beasts, feeding Kent more blood.
If it would take the blood of millions of beasts on Planet Rainy for Kent to come out of his seclusion as a monster, then that was what they would do.
Kent sensed their intentions, so he promised to make good use of their efforts.
Thankfully, absorbing the [Dragon Ascension Fruit] had done more good than he expected.
Although the tower still had a few hours before it finished its upgrade, Kent was able to access the system interface, so when the messages started to flood in, he could only smile.
[You have absorbed a god-grade Dragon Ascension Fruit.]
[Congratulations, you have awakened 35% of your bloodline.]
[Congratulations, you have unlocked 10,000 Blood Runes.
[Congratulations, you can now unlock two more innate talents]
This message came when he absorbed the fruit.
While he expected a 5% boost in bloodline awakening, he ended up getting 9% instead.
It was already 26% when he ate the fruit, so he is now 35%.
Naturally, that was more than he expected, especially when he had suffered to reach the 26% awakening mark.
But things did not end there.
As blood was absorbed into his body, he began to sense something even more profound happening.
Initially, he could not put his finger on it.
However, his confusion was cleared when a second batch of messages started to appear.
[You are absorbing a large amount of blood essence.
This phenomenon has triggered a sudden awakening.]
[Congratulations, you have unlocked a variant innate ability: Blood Tempering]
[Blood Tempering]
[Rank: Innate]
[Description: Using blood from any source, temper your blood, inheriting some innate aspects of the blood used in the tempering.]
Kent blinked a few times when these messages were displayed.
There was no way he actually read that right.
Tempering his blood with another’s blood—how does that even work?
Blood is intangible, so how then can he temper it?
His confusion, however, was soon cleared when he realized the thing being tempered was not his blood, but rather his blood seals.
He had no idea how any of it was possible, especially when Chaos had not gone through this process before.
He had no memory of him ever tempering his blood runes.
From what he had recalled so far, after all blood runes had been awakened, he would then proceed to the next stage, which is Blood Tattoo Creation.
Tempering his blood runes was all too new to him.
But it was happening to him, and for a moment, his mind scanned through Chaos’ memories to look for a clue.
After a while, he sighed.
A thought came to mind, but he couldn’t place his finger on it.
"I have seen something similar before; I just can’t remember where," he continued, going through his memories for another two hours, but nothing came to mind.𝙛𝒓𝓮𝒆𝔀𝒆𝙗𝓷𝒐𝙫𝒆𝙡.𝒄𝓸𝓶
So he changed his approach and started looking at the skills and techniques related to his path—the Slaughter Path.
This time, it took only five minutes to find what he was looking for.
Hidden within the expanded description of the [Bone Tempering Art], he saw that the blood runes formed could have different colors—four, to be precise.
"When formed, they come in crimson color.
Many beasts, and even humans, have this blood-essence innate color.
However, after some evolution, they will become golden.
Monarch-level beasts have this color.
The third color is crimson-gold, which happens when the third evolution is met.
Only a few Beast manaed to reach this, and in the vast universe, they were called Overlord Beasts.
As for the last color, which is Dark-Gold, no beast ever recorded in history managed to attain this."
"Chaos only reached the first evolution, at least from the memories I have now.
But if that was the case for him, then what would happen when I attain the second or even third evolution before forming my blood tattoos?"
Suddenly, Kent felt like he had nearly been conspired against.
"That bastard, he clearly said nothing about this." The image of the Slaughter King appeared in his mind, causing him to grit his teeth.

If not for the unfortunate accident that happened when Vexthra killed the beasts, and he ended up absorbing the blood mist, he would not have awakened the [Blood Tempering Art] innate ability, which meant he would not have even known of this evolution path.
"Damnit, that sly bastard." Kent made a mental note not to tell him his mind when they meet again.
"But then again, I wonder if the tempering will continue even after I form the blood tattoos."
A smile appeared on his face as he sensed the blood being absorbed by him suddenly start to increase.
"Since we are here now, then I might as well eat the [Blood Life Fruit] and see where we go from there."
He reached for the crimson-colored fruit and bit into it, savoring the metallic taste of blood souring his tongue.
He did not mind and continued to bite and eat.
This time too, he regulated the blood energy flowing through his body through parts like his brain, eyes, nose, ears, teeth, ribs, and all kinds of body parts, down to his nails.
Soon, the first few messages appeared.
[You have absorbed a god-grade Blood Life Fruit.]
[Congratulations, you have unlocked 10,000 Blood Runes.
...a few seconds later, a new message appeared.
[Congratulations, you have unlocked 5,000 Blood Runes.
[Congratulations, you have unlocked all 105,000 blood runes]
...but things did not end there.
In fact, it was merely the start of something that even if the Slaughter King were to witness it, his jaws would have to be supported by large metallic pillars.
[You have absorbed a large amount of Blood Qi.]
[Your Eternal Draconic Cultivation is trying to absorb some into your cultivation.]
[You have leveled up.
Rank: Level 8 Heavenly Ascension]
[You have leveled up.
Rank: Level 9 Heavenly Ascension]
[You have reached the peak]
[You still have excess Blood Qi in your body.]
[The Bone Tempering Art has been triggered, and it is trying to make use of the excess energy.]

Soon, however, the decision was made, and the results were something he never saw coming.

[You have met the requirement to evolve your blood to the second evolution stage]

chapters.title: Chapter 1548: Forming the First Chaos Heart (4)
paragraphs: [You have met the requirement to evolve your blood to the second evolution stage]
[Congratulations, your blood has evolved to the next stage: Golden Monarch Blood]
[Golden Monarch Blood]
[Type: 2nd Blood Evolution]
[Description: You are a monarch to all beasts. Your presence radiates royalty and demands absolute respect from all inferior beings.]
[You have awakened two bloodline innate aspect abilities]
[Monarch’s Presence]
[Rank: Innate]

[Description: Your presence radiates royalty and demands absolute respect from all inferior beings. All lower existences must bow before your majestic presence, or they risk invoking your wrath. You have the right to look down on all lower beings.]
[Monarch’s Authority]
[Rank: Innate]
[Description: Your command is absolute and cannot be disobeyed or resisted. All who dare to resist your command will face the wrath of your absolute will.]
[Evolution requirements met. Chaos Dragon Authority + Monarch’s Authority ↠ Chaos Monarch’s Sovereignty]𝚏𝗿𝗲𝐞𝐰𝚎𝕓𝐧𝚘𝘃𝗲𝐥.𝐜𝚘𝕞
[Chaos Monarch’s Sovereignty]
[Rank: Innate+]

[Description: You are the Chaos Monarch. Your authority is absolute. Even among the ranks of other monarchs, your Chaos will transcend all. In times of chaos, your authority has no bounds, allowing you to embody the essence of Chaos.]
"Well, that took a dark turn real quick," Kent smirked, an evil look appearing in his eyes.
Deep within him, an untamed, arrogant will had awakened, making him feel a sudden disdain for the presence he sensed.

On the outside, Vexthra and her friends felt a sudden will that transcended everything else wash over them. For a moment, they all felt like going down on their knees and prostrate themselves at his feet.
However, as the feeling crept in, it suddenly vanished, and a voice came from the cave where Kent was cultivating.
"Sorry, ladies. I lost control there for a moment."
Vexthra smirked. Miryssa narrowed her eyes. Inaya frowned, and Ainna gritted her teeth, cursing the brat who had nearly made her bow down at his feet.
"This bastard. I will strangle him to death one day."
Vexthra tapped her on the shoulder and whispered into her ear, "I would love to see how that turns out for you."

Ainna recalled what she saw inside the harem tower, causing her cheeks to turn red. Knowing she had no way to win this time, she vanished and started unleashing hell on the beasts, further adding to Kent’s growing strength.
"Ah, the unfortunate struggle. We all went through it," Miryssa smirked and also joined the massacre. Inaya and Vexthra followed.

Kent, who saw and heard them through the [Soul Map], smiled and started to wait for all the Blood Qi in his system to be absorbed before he would start the third phase of his cultivation—Body Tempering using the Dragon Spirit Essence.
[Rainbow Dragon Monarch - Reincarnated during the Chaos Era]

Meanwhile, all over the universe, terrifying beings—beasts, humans, demons, angels, spirits—whether from this universe or from other realms beyond its confines—feel their backs break into a cold sweat when a sudden cold wind blows past them.
Sleeping somewhere in her private world, a beauty with rainbow-colored hair, nails, and eyebrows slowly opened her rainbow eyes, a smile forming on her lips.
"So you’re finally back, huh?" She raised her head from her pillow and stretched her arms. "My sweet Chaos, how I missed you."
During the Primordial Era, she was known as the Rainbow Dragon Monarch, a member of the Dragon Council, a cabal of dragons that Chaos formed during the last moments of the Primordial Era.
She was among the powerhouses that, at one point, were enemies of Chaos, but when the time came, they died fighting beside him when people he trusted betrayed and abandoned him.
She stood up and walked to the window overlooking the beautiful rainbow trees, perfectly lined all around her world.
"We will meet soon enough, little Chaos."
[Crystal Dragon Monarch - Reincarnated during the Shadow Era]
Somewhere else, also in his private world, the Crystal Dragon Monarch lifted his head and looked up at the sky and smiled. "Ah, I guess my days of peace are over."
One could even see a crazy look appear in his eyes. Far from his mansion, inside a huge vault, a pale spear trembled with excitement, sensing its master’s insatiable will to battle slowly rising.
"I guess that madman is back. Master only feels excitement when he is close."
During the Shadow Era, when the Ruthless Bandit dominated, the Crystal Monarch was also reincarnated along with his weapon, the Crystal Heart Spear.
[Darkness Dragon Monarch & Shadow Dragon Monarch - Reincarnated during the Dark Era]

Somewhere else, the third strongest monarch after Chaos and Ignarax (Flame Dragon Monarch) plunged his scythe into the head of an abomination of a beast. Twisting the long handle of his weapon, a pale smile formed on his face.
He turned and looked at a shadow coiling around another abomination and smirked. "My dear shadow, looks like he is back."
"Who?" a feminine voice came from the shadow. Because she was intangible, she did not feel the sudden authority the monarch of darkness felt.
"Who else if not that madman Chaos?"
"Oh, I see. We better hurry back and use the small opening we have to torture him before he becomes a monster yet again."
"You read my mind, sweetheart." A chilling smile escaped his mouth. He jumped back into the chaos and started slaughtering more abominations.
During the Primordial Era, they challenged Chaos to a duel 101 times and lost all. However, now, it seemed they did not want to lose.
[Lightning Dragon Monarch - Reincarnated during the Divine Era]
Among the 24 Dragon Monarchs that fought and died for Chaos, he was the first to reincarnate.
He was there when the foreign race invaded, and he answered when Lord Genesis called all able warriors to take up arms and fight for the universe.

That call made by Lord Genesis triggered his memories of his past life, and so he fought and bled yet again. This time, however, he did not die, for the battle ended before he could face an opponent he could not kill.
During the Primordial Era, he was among the few who never clashed with Chaos. He saw Chaos as a superior existence, so instead of hating him and trying to prove himself, he sought his guidance.
They became friends, and for years, they shared knowledge with each other.
Today, seated somewhere in the realm of lightning and thunder, he smiled and muttered...
"Big Brother has returned. Looks like I have to hurry and attain the level of Primordial Lightning before we meet."
In several other places, the other monarchs reacted similarly. They all felt happy to sense that the Primordial Chaos Dragon had returned.
But it was not just them. Other beasts, humans, and all kinds of brave warriors that were affected by the Spell of Origin felt his return.

Not all of them were strong enough to reincarnate with their memories, but when his presence passed over them, they felt the urge to take up arms and rally behind him, for they knew that with him leading the charge, nothing could stand against them.
It is rare for someone to have this much effect on people, but Chaos did, and this time, he is bound to lead a much bigger and stronger army into battle.
Of course, when allies sense his presence, the foes are bound to do so also.

chapters.title: Chapter 1549: Forming the First Chaos Heart (5)
paragraphs: [Void Realm]
Seated on a large black stone, a pale man with two dark, twisted horns opened his blue jade eyes and gazed down at a multicolored star several billion light-years away.
His gaze seemed to have pierced through the barriers of the stars. After a few moments, he turned away and smirked...
"So you are finally back, little dragon." A look of disdain filled his eyes and face as he spoke those words.

He made a fist and gritted his teeth, looking at the scar on his arm. "You won the last time, little dragon. This time, however, wait for me to personally slice you into several pieces until there is not even a bit of you left."
During the Primordial Era, he was instructed by the Void Sovereign to march his army to the Infinity Universe and take control of it, just as they had done with several other universes.

He accepted the mission, thinking it would be a walk in the park. Unfortunately for him, when he arrived, an existence he later came to know as the Primordial Chaos Dragon stood in his way, and no matter what he tried, he was there to stop him.
In the end, before he was banished from the Infinity Universe, Chaos made one last attempt to sever his head but ended up carving a large wound into his left arm.
Even after billions of years, the scar still remains.
When he returned to the Void Realm with only one-third of his army, he was banished to the Void Borders and stripped of his role as a Void Monarch, reduced to a mere Void Border Guard.
His unit was absorbed by the other Void Monarchs, and since then, he had been left to rot at the borders.

His defeat, compounded by his failure and polished by his humiliation, fueled his rage, and for billions of years, he waited for Chaos to return. Now that he had returned, he knew it would only be a matter of time before the doom gates opened again.
This time, he wanted to wash away his humiliation and use Chaos’ blood to redeem himself.
For now, he could only bide his time and wait for a chance to reveal itself.
Kent felt a sudden chill seep deep into his body, causing him to sigh. "Ah, my bad luck. It seems an old enemy has sensed my presence and has already started plotting against me."
A pale smile formed on his face, and then he looked at the countdown before his eyes.
[Time Until Upgrade: 2 hours]

The Blood Qi was still being absorbed, but he was now waiting for the Tower to finish her upgrade before he would start the third phase. With the kind of tempering he had in mind, he needed his tower by his side when he went through it all.
For now, he could only wait.
[You have formed 1,000 blood runes. Total: 188,000]
[You have formed 1,000 blood runes. Total: 189,000]
[You have formed 1,000 blood runes. Total: 190,000]
[You have formed 1,000 blood runes. Total: 199,000]
’Ten seconds more to go.’ Kent sighed and started to count down. Just when the countdown struck zero, he felt his connection to the tower reestablish itself, stronger than before.
’Damn.’
Kent felt so much happening within him and inside the tower that he wondered just what had happened to her.
Inside the tower, everyone looked up when the sky suddenly changed color from blue to golden. Then the changes started to manifest.
First, the spiritual qi in the air was purified, becoming even denser. If before the upgrade, it was 10%, it has now increased to at least 250%.

Aside from that, the 13 moons in the sky had also become more visible, and birds appeared in the air. A very vast forest filled with all kinds of spirit beasts also appeared, making it one of the many attractions to appear.
Waterfalls, mountain ranges, and a few other places to explore had also appeared, turning the Tower City into a one-of-a-kind place.

In the other towers, great changes had occurred. Inside the Legion Tower, more training grounds had appeared. The dungeons in there had also undergone some changes—ones that would push the legion into training even more.
The Harem Tower saw some changes as well. As for the Soul, Sword, and Alchemy Towers, Kent would have to review the changes that had occurred there.
The Guardian Tower had also undergone some changes, allowing Kent to better protect his worlds. So far, over 100 gateways have appeared. Through each gateway led to a planet under his protection.
Lastly, one more tower had appeared.
But while all of this was amazing, the main shocking upgrade was the one Kent was staring at.
Just when the upgrade was complete, a small tower materialized before him, and before he could wonder what it was, it transformed into a tiny child.
She had a ponytail, a pair of white angelic wings, and a fluffy tail. She was very cute, almost as cute as a smaller version of Gaia.
"Master... I am human now, hehehe..."
She landed on Kent’s shoulder, planting a kiss on his cheek...
"I can see that, Tower," Kent smiled and asked, "Can I still call you Tower, or do you have a different name? Perhaps I should give you a more human name."
"Tower is okay, master." She jumped, flapping her wings as she landed on Kent’s other shoulder.
"Glad to see you in human form, Tower. Though I have to ask, how were you able to undergo an upgrade when I have yet to become an Immortal?"
Tower smiled cutely and turned her head away slightly.

"I stole some of the master’s soul essence to open a small path to my next upgrade. I figured since the master can’t level up his soul cultivation yet, I would rather undergo a pseudo upgrade so I will be better prepared for when the master forms his Chaos Heart."
She turned and looked at Kent with an apologetic expression. "I hope the master is not mad at me for not asking for permission first."
Kent reached out and poked her cute little cheek. "Don’t be silly, Tower. I can never be mad at you. If anything, why haven’t you done so months ago?"

"Well, the master had just welcomed over 16 million beings into the Tower City, so there was no better time to farm soul essence than at that very moment. Though I have to say, master, I never expected the Tower City to have already grown to this level."
"Me too. I can now feel my soul growing stronger by the second. It is amazing."

Tower nodded. "I guess once the star system in the medium world has been completely taken over by your agents, I can trigger the upgrade mechanism and let it undergo a full upgrade. I will initiate a world upgrade and transform that star system into a Supreme High World."
"You can do that?" Kent furrowed his brow. However, just before Tower could reply to him, a message appeared before him.
[You have fully absorbed the Blood Qi in your system.]
"I guess it’s back to business." Looking at the second message, he smiled wildly and then turned to the Dragon Spirit Essence.
[You have formed 1,000 blood runes. Total: 250,000]
Tower flew back and sat in a lotus posture opposite Kent. "I am ready when you are master."
